• They are rarely used by random raiders and Talon Company mercs.
• Four on the shelf in the National Guard depot's armory.
• Police batons are found most commonly in Vault 101 being used by security guards.
• There have been instances of them on dead bodies of insane survivors in Vault 106.
• FO3BS Police batons can be found next to skeletons with nearby sunglasses and police hats in the Presidential sub level.
• FO3PL Two on a shelf in the St. Aubin Medical Facility's underground lab, room in the southeast.

itm_00004344.summary: Plasma Rifle is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 45, uses Microfusion Cell, value 1800 caps). Linked to quests: Protecting the Water Way.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The plasma rifle uses microfusion cells, and can discharge up to twelve green, self-illuminated plasma bolts before requiring a reload.

The plasma rifle fires projectiles that inflict potentially heavy damage at a fairly quick semi-automatic rate of fire. The plasma bolt moves at subsonic speeds, giving enemies the chance to dodge the plasma bolts. Because of this, the plasma rifle is most effective in close to medium-range combat. It empties its 12-shot magazine rather quickly, and its reload time is somewhat longer than most other small guns/energy weapons. Maintenance is a combination of perks and drawbacks: Like other energy weapons, it has a high maximum condition compared to small guns but is expensive and/or difficult to repair.

A plasma rifle in poor condition (under 10%) can cost over 1,000 bottle caps to repair.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text: A3-21's plasma rifle - Obtained from Harkness at the end of The Replicated Man quest. A3-21's plasma rifle is one of the most powerful energy weapons in the game.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Within the Taft Tunnel, held by a Tesla armored soldier in the room where Doctor Li opens the locked door. One needs to hop on top of a barrel and onto the lamp and onto the beams to reach the soldiers.
• Fort Independence, inside a weapons armory (the key to the armory door is inside one of the footlockers in the quarters).
• The Citadel laboratory, in Peabody's room, on the table.
• Sometimes, one can purchase this weapon in the Citadel armory.
• Standard issue for Enclave soldiers wearing Tesla armor.
• FO3BS Used by Enclave soldiers wearing Enclave Hellfire armor.
• FO3BS Officer Lepelletier is also armed with one. It is possible to obtain it by passing a Speech check.
• FO3BS Paladin Tristan carries one.
• FO3PL Occasionally carried by smugglers.

itm_00004343.summary: Plasma Pistol is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 25, uses Energy Cell, value 360 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
It fires superheated bolts of green plasma. The plasma pistol uses a semi-automatic firing action, along with sixteen shots from an energy cell. Upon firing the weapon, a large green burst of plasma is created which partially obstructs the view. The plasma bolt can be used to ignite the gas from a distance.

Durability:
The plasma pistol can fire a total of about 400 bolts, the equivalent of 25 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text: • MPLX Novasurge FO3MZ- The prototype version of the Enclave's plasma pistol that was produced before the war, the Novasurge is about three times as powerful as the normal plasma pistol. However, it has double the weight and uses twice as much ammunition per shot as the regular plasma pistol.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• The plasma pistol can usually only be found being carried by Enclave officers. Officers can be found with most groups of Enclave soldiers, at locations such as the deathclaw sanctuary and Raven Rock.
• The Broken Steel add-on adds several more locations where plasma pistols can be found:
• Enclave Hellfire troopers carry the plasma pistol as a sidearm.
• Split Jack will wield one in the side quest Protecting the Water Way.
• One is a part of the requisition leftovers given by Scribe Bigsley after completing the Protecting the Water Way quest.
• One can be found in full condition in Fort Bannister on the table in the same tent Paladin Jensen is tied up in.
• FO3MZ One on a table in the weapons lab.
• FO3MZ One in the Cryo lab, west room, on a shelf with a Tesla helmet.

itm_00004342.summary: Nuka-Grenade is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 1, value 50 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
Nuka-grenades are crude yet effective thrown explosives comprised of a sealed tin can filled with Nuka-Cola Quantum, Abraxo cleaner and turpentine, which react with each other in a radioactive explosion. Around the middle of the tin are several strips of masking tape with the words "RADIATION" and "DANGER" written on both sides.

When thrown, the grenade erupts into a blue and orange fireball. Flames and radiation linger for a few seconds after the explosion.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• For schematics and component locations, see Schematics - Nuka grenade.
• Unlike most craftable weapons in Fallout 3, Nuka-grenades can be found in the wasteland.
• There is a Nuka-grenade on the Mechanist's workbench.
• A Nuka-grenade can be found on a workbench in the Evergreen Mills Foundry.
• FO3BS Another is located on the second floor from the top of the Old Olney S. Wilson Building in a crate, under a desk above and to the left of the entrance.
• FO3BS There are three Nuka-grenades in the Citadel armory, however, they can only be accessed if the Citadel was blown up in the Who Dares Wins quest.
• FO3MZ One can be found in the engineering core of Mothership Zeta.

itm_00004340.summary: Missile Launcher is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 20, uses Missile, value 500 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
A fairly common and powerful big gun, the potential of the missile launcher is somewhat reduced by its long reload time and inability to kill anything stronger than a super mutant brute in a single shot.

Durability:
The missile launcher can fire about 83 missiles from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Miss Launcher - A unique variant found in Fort Independence.
• Sim version FO3OA - A sim-only version of the weapon which differs only in health (essentially non-degrading).

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Missile launchers can be wielded by a wide variety of both enemies and friendlies. When encountered in squads, super mutants, raiders and Talon Company mercs usually have at least one member wielding a heavy weapon, which can be a missile launcher.
• One can be found around the back of the Washington Monument, along with an ammunition box full of missiles.
• Commander Jabsco uses the missile launcher as his primary weapon.
• One near some metal shelves in the Capitol Building's rotunda (west entrance section).
• Two on a table in Wheaton Armory.
• FO3OA One can be obtained from the VSS armory after completing Operation: Anchorage!.
• FO3PL Occasionally carried by smugglers.
• FO3MZ One on a shelf in the cargo hold, near the research lab exit.

itm_0000433f.summary: Minigun is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 5, uses 5mm Round, value 1000 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: As one of the most common heavy weapons in the game, the minigun is comparatively easy to find and repair, as well as one of the few big guns easy to find ammunition for; nearly every super mutant brute encountered with one has at least 30 5mm rounds for it. It is also carried extensively by Brotherhood of Steel units, Brotherhood Outcast units, Enclave soldiers, as well as occasionally on some raiders and slavers. This is offset somewhat by the minigun's high rate of fire, which quickly uses up ammunition. The minigun is designed as a sustained-firing weapon, and its rate of fire of 20 rounds per second means that it can fire up to 240 rounds in only 12 seconds of continuous firing. Because of this, those who intend to make use of it should buy additional ammunition, which is generally quite plentiful and cheap at shops.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Eugene - a unique variant obtained as a reward for completing the side quest Reilly's Rangers. Better damage and durability.
• FO3OA Sim verison - A digital replication in the Anchorage Reclamation simulation. Significantly higher HP. It must be pickpocketed from the T-51b soldiers dropped by the vertibird as the pulse field is approached. Once acquired, 5mm rounds can be drawn from the ammo dispensers.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• National Guard depot - One can be found in the armory storage.
• Wheaton Armory - Behind the Very Hard locked door.
• Hubris Comics- Wielded by Mad Johnny Wes.
• The Roach King uses this as their primary weapon.
• A fully repaired minigun can be found in Fort Independence, lower level.
• Can be found on some Brotherhood of Steel members.
• Several super mutant brutes use the minigun, including the one by the Mall, near the Capitol Building.
• FO3BS On the table behind Desmond Lockheart, when entering Calvert Mansion.
• FO3BS Wielded by the boss tribal attacking in Calvert Mansion.

itm_0000433e.summary: The pulse mine consists of a proximity fuse and miniaturized EMP device enclosed in a gray metal casing screwed to the base. Armed status is indicated by four red diodes situated on top of the cover.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The pulse mine will begin beeping when a target comes within a short distance to it until it is disarmed or it detonates. The time until detonation depends on the Explosives skill of the person setting it off. Both soft and armored/robot targets will activate the fuse.

On detonation, the pulse mine creates an electromagnetic field affecting any functioning robots and turrets. The blast deals little damage to non-robot targets in proximity to the detonating device.

The pulse mine can be disarmed with a high enough Explosives skill or simply avoided with the perk Light Step.

The pulse mine will become live and likely to cause instant death after it's dropped into a non-player character's pants (inventory) via theft.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Found in mine boxes.
• Talon Company mercenaries may carry some pulse mines with them.
• Enclave soldiers and officers are often supplied with one.
• They are also almost never found in the wasteland, at least armed. A single live one can be found in the National Archives Rotunda.
• Four on the shelf in the National Guard depot's armory.
• FO3OA Two in the Outcast outpost's armory, available after the completion of Operation: Anchorage!
• FO3PL Two on a shelf in St. Aubin Medical Facility's underground lab, room in the southeast.

itm_0000433d.summary: Plasma Mine is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 1, value 50 caps). Linked to quests: Wasteland Survival Guide.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The plasma mine erupts into a fiery cloud of green plasma when it explodes.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• FO3OA There is one inside the Outcast outpost once one has completed the Operation Anchorage add-on.
• There are at least six armed plasma mines scattered around an Enclave camp southwest of Fort Independence, along with more in crates or on Enclave infantry.
• They are common in mine boxes in Enclave camps. They are also common loot for Enclave soldiers and officers.
• FO3MZ Some can also be found in the weapons lab.

Boxes with plasma mines:
• One plasma mine guaranteed, 75% chance of 2 to 6 mines.
• Three in the Citadel laboratory.
• Two in Raven Rock, behind a force field when leaving, near the way out.

itm_0000433c.summary: Frag Mine is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 1, value 25 caps). Linked to quests: Wasteland Survival Guide, Big Trouble in Big Town.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The frag mine looks like a tan shaped disk with a black gear and red button on top. The frag mine will begin beeping when a target comes within a short distance to it until it is disarmed or it detonates. The time until detonation depends on the Explosives skill of the person setting it off.

Frag mines can be disarmed with an Explosives skill of 1, meaning anyone, regardless of their statistics, will be capable of doing so. If the Lone Wanderer has the Light Step perk, the mine will not be triggered at all.

To use a frag mine, it must first be equipped like any other weapon. Firing with it arms and drops the mine a short distance ahead of the miner. The mine will be triggered when any non-follower non-player character comes within a certain distance. Neither the miner nor their companions will trigger it.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text: • Sim version FO3OA - A version used exclusively in the Anchorage Reclamation simulation, it differs from the standard Fallout 3 variant only in that it cannot be dropped, although it still can be transferred between containers or given to companions.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
Armed mines:
• There are a total of 67 frag mines found scattered around Minefield for the quest Wasteland Survival Guide.
• Seven south of Alexandria Arms.
• Two south of Arlington Library at a Talon Company post, near the map's border. Two more to the east.
• Five in Arlington Library's media archive.
• 13 can be found on a bridge just west of the Anchorage Memorial fast travel point.
• Three at Bethesda ruins.
• Four in the Canterbury tunnels.
• Six around Charnel house.
• 17 at a raider camp northwest of Charnel house.
• Two in drainage chamber Signal Sierra Victor.
• 19 around the center ornament at Dupont Circle.
• Three in the Dupont Circle station.
• Two at Dupont Northeast.
• Five near train tracks east/northeast of Evergreen Mills. Four more a litte further to the east.
• Two in the Fairfax Metro station, near the CW exit.

itm_0000433a.summary: A bottlecap mine is a craftable land mine in Fallout 3. It does five times the damage of a standard frag mine.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: Bottlecap mines can be constructed by the player character, using the bottlecap mine schematics. Building it requires a lunchbox, ten caps, a sensor module, and a cherry bomb. Locating additional schematics allows one to build more bottlecap mines at a time. They need to be armed and placed to be used. The bottlecap mine can be planted on an NPC to kill them.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• A single bottlecap mine can be found on nearly every workbench in the game, with a few exceptions. This includes the purchasable workbench for the Megaton house and Tenpenny Tower suite. In shops and other NPC-owned locations, taking it will usually be considered stealing.
• Three can be found in the Super-Duper Mart.
• All of the parts can also be found in Pinkerton's room under Rivet City, including a pile of caps.
In the locations below, all bottlecap mines are found on workbenches.
• One in the Anchorage Memorial facility.
• One in the Arlington House.
• One in Bethesda offices east.
• One in Craterside Supply.
• One in Dominic and Machete's house.
• One in the drainage chamber near Signal Sierra Victor.
• One in the Evergreen Mills bazaar.
• One in Fort Independence's lower level.

itm_00004339.summary: Mesmetron is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 1, uses Mesmetron Power Cell, value 500 caps). Linked to quests: Strictly Business.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: Originally developed by the pre-War Implied Hypnotics, Inc., the Mesmetron was created as an experimental "non-lethal subjugation device" in a joint project with the United States military. It primarily operates by sending a series of waves that the brain attempts to decode, but because the target's synapses are being overwhelmed by the neural static, the brain becomes confused and switches off important higher-level mental functions and voluntary motor control, Still in its testing phase, the weapon was found to have the potential to trigger two undesirable side-effects: extremely increased aggression or a "resonant brain wave feedback loop" which resulted in spontaneous cranial eruption.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
When used on the specified quest non-player characters during Strictly Business, it puts them into a hypnotic stupor, allowing the player character to rob and enslave them (by putting a slave collar on them) and send them to Paradise Falls. It also appears to work on many other non-player characters (aside from quest related ones) but can simply send them into a berserk frenzy in which they turn hostile to the Lone Wanderer and every other non-player character in the area. Occasionally, victims will run several steps before their heads explode.

Durability:
The Mesmetron can fire a total of 2500 waves, or 500 full cells, from full condition before breaking.

Using the Mesmetron:
Using the Mesmetron on a non-player character can have three different outcomes.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text: • FO3PL Microwave emitter - a unique variant designed for killing targets instead of neutralizing them, and powered by energy cells instead of Mesmetron power cells.

itm_00004337.summary: Lead Pipe is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 9, value 75 caps). Linked to quests: Protecting the Water Way.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
One of the ends has tape wrapped around it to improve grip, while the other is heavily corroded and/or bloodstained, and topped with a pipe fitting. Though it has a short reach, it has decent damage and a fast swing speed.

Durability:
The lead pipe can successfully strike about 667 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Lead pipes can be found on random raiders and wastelanders.
• They can found in some metro stations, like Warrington trainyard.
• Can be found on the Garys in Vault 108.
• Can be found on insane survivors in Vault 106.
• FO3BS A stash of 17, which are grouped as a single collectible item in perfect condition, can be found in the mobile base crawler's storage room, close to one of the middle deck access hatches to the entrance bay.
• FO3BS A large amount of fully repaired lead pipes can be found in the Jefferson Memorial in Bigsley's office.
• FO3BS One can be obtained from Split Jack, if one convinces him that they are a "new recruit."

itm_00004336.summary: Laser Rifle is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 23, uses Microfusion Cell, value 1000 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The laser rifle performs admirably at medium and long ranges, where its accurate semi-automatic fire combined with its large ammunition capacity makes short work of most opponents. Its semi-automatic nature prevents it from being a viable close quarters combat weapon. As such, the laser rifle is a good weapon for traveling through the open wastelands where dispatching enemies at a distance is a frequent opportunity. Its rapid semi-automatic fire, sizable magazine, the minimum spread of 0 (meaning potentially perfect accuracy), extremely effective range, and exceptionally low AP cost allows the laser rifle to really stand out. A deadly critical hit from this weapon, as with other laser weapons, will not only kill enemies but also turn them into a pile of colored sparkling ashes, which can still be looted as normal.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Wazer Wifle - This unique variant of the AER9 has higher damage and durability, as well as a larger magazine. It is obtained from Biwwy in Little Lamplight for five hundred caps, for two hundred and fifty caps with a Barter skill check, or free with the Child at Heart perk.
• FO3TP Metal Blaster - This unique variant of the AER9 fires nine beams at once, using one microfusion cell similar to the Protectron's Gaze laser pistol. This feature, coupled with its remarkably high damage-per-shot makes it a devastating short to close-range weapon, though its effectiveness greatly diminishes at a range with the "shotgun effect." It can be obtained by bringing fifty steel ingots to Everett in The Pitt.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Low level Enclave soldiers typically have laser rifles (usually at about 1/3 condition).
• Several laser rifles can be found inside Raven Rock.
• Laying next to a dead Brotherhood initiate in the north office building off of Falls Church (the one without Initiate Pek).
• In a cabinet in the Talon Company camp.
• On a shelf in the overseer's office of Vault 92.
• In a tent near a wrecked army truck northeast of Smith Casey's garage, guarded by a level adjusted robot. Sometimes random creatures or patrolling Brotherhood Outcasts will destroy the robot.
• One in a cabinet in the Family's home. Must be stolen.
• One next to a dead mercenary in Old Olney.
• Can be discovered in a room next to some skeletons during the Stealing Independence quest.
• Carried by some Talon Company mercs and Regulators at higher levels.

itm_00004335.summary: Laser Pistol is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 12, uses Energy Cell, value 320 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
Like other energy weapons, the laser pistol has a multiplier on critical chance, making critical hits more frequent with this weapon over most others. Critical hits that are fatal reduce enemies to smoking piles of ash, but this process does not damage any equipment or items the victim was holding or wearing prior to their death. The beam will ignite any gas leaks that it passes through.

Laser pistols are somewhat scarce early in the game. Shops and merchants that sell weapons are the most reliable source of laser pistols. The ammunition for the laser pistol is reasonably plentiful. Energy cells can often be found in ammunition boxes, other various containers, and on destroyed robots. One can find copious amounts of energy cells in the National Archives sub-basement or in the RobCo facility.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Colonel Autumn's laser pistol - A unique variant carried by Colonel Autumn prior to the release of the add-on Broken Steel.
• FO3BS Colonel Autumn's laser pistol (Broken Steel) - A unique variant carried by Autumn with the add-on Broken Steel installed. It has identical stats to the Smuggler's End, but is one pound heavier.
• Cross' laser pistol - A unique, non-playable version used by Star Paladin Cross, with identical stats to the regular version.
• Protectron's Gaze - A unique variant given by the Mechanist.
• Smuggler's End - A unique variant carried by Elder Lyons.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Two in poor condition can be found in the deli to the right of the cash registers at the Super-Duper Mart.
• On a table along with several energy cells just inside the entrance of Vault 92.
• Another decent condition pistol can be found in the Farragut West Metro Station tunnels, in a safe that is unlocked by a nearby terminal. It can be found during the Following in His Footsteps quest.
• It can also be found on Initiate Jennings while aiding Lyons' Pride in their defense of Galaxy News Radio.
• It is commonly used by both the Brotherhood of Steel and Enclave as a sidearm.
• The dead Regulator will have one.
• Armitage, Ben Canning, the Mechanist, Tinker Joe and William Brandice all use them.
• Paladin Gunny carries one.
• FO3PL One in St. Aubin Medical Facility's underground lab, room in the southeast.

itm_00004334.summary: Knife is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 4, value 20 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
This weapon appears to be a rusty kitchen knife.

Durability:
The knife can successfully strike about 500 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Ant's Sting - obtained by siding with the AntAgonizer in The Superhuman Gambit, Ant's Sting is slightly stronger than the regular knife, and deals poison damage over time.
• Slasher knife - appears in Tranquility Lane and can only be obtained outside of the simulation through console commands.
• FO3PL Ritual knife - even more powerful than the Ant's Sting, the ritual knife only uses 12 AP for each V.A.T.S. attack.
• FO3PL Toy knife - using even less AP than the ritual knife, 10 compared to 12, the toy knife uses the lowest amount of AP for any weapon in Fallout 3. However, it does very little damage, much less than the regular knife.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text: • Knives can be found on random wastelanders and raiders, in kitchens of abandoned homes, hospitals and many other places across the Wastelands.

itm_00004333.summary: Hunting Rifle is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 25, uses .32 Caliber Round, value 150 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The hunting rifle is a very accurate weapon and has the best zoom of the non-scoped weapons. The hunting rifle's spread can make the weapon hard to use for sniping at long ranges without V.A.T.S. A skilled player can use this weapon to great effect in most situations, even close-quarters combat inside buildings. The rifle is commonly found in the wasteland, facilitating repairs or replacement.

While the hunting rifle is depicted as a very accurate weapon, the in-game weapon model does not have rear or front sights, nor does it have a scope. While this means very little in-game as unscoped weapons in Fallout 3 don't use iron sights, in reality, this would make the weapon extremely difficult to aim at longer ranges and would render it almost worthless beyond close-range encounters, even to a skilled marksman.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text: • Ol' Painless - More powerful variant of the hunting rifle that has a higher fire rate and deals more damage, but is less durable.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Lucas Simms' house has a damaged rifle sitting on a shelf in a room upstairs. The door requires a Lockpick skill of 50, you can pickpocket the house key from Lucas Simms, or you can use an empty, upturned metal barrel (carried to and placed near the water processing plant railing) to jump onto Lucas Simms' roof and enter his house via the roof hatch (which is never locked) to his lookout point. The rifle must be stolen.
• Just west of Vault 101 is an old barn with a random encounter spawn point located inside. Going up the stairs in the barn will reveal a hunting rifle and.32 ammunition next to a skeleton and a ham radio.
• There is a damaged rifle behind Springvale school among a pile of nuclear waste barrels (in a fenced-in area with a locked gate).

itm_00004332.summary: Plasma Grenade is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 1, value 50 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The plasma grenade is a magnetically-sealed plasma delivery unit, with detonating explosives, which creates a large blast of green superheated plasma on detonation. There is a high chance to cripple limbs and a critical hit will reduce the target to green goo, even though thrown grenade criticals deal no extra damage.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Carried by Enclave officers out in the wasteland.
• Carried in Lucky Harith's caravan inventory if one has invested the maximum investment into his caravan.
• Two in the Citadel laboratory.
• Found inside a toilet tank in the southwest of Northwest Seneca Station.
• One in a pot in the Temple of the Union storeroom, in a bucket.
• One in the bunker in the National Guard depot (armory).
• One in the tent at the wastelander tent and sniper vista, in a bucket on a shelf.
• Three in the Wheaton Armory's weapon and ammo room.
• FO3OA There is one inside the Outcast outpost after completion of the Operation: Anchorage add-on.
• FO3BS Two at Adams Air Force Base, middle hangar, in a bin with a teddy bear against the wall, under the stairs.
• FO3BS Four in the Citadel armory, if one chooses to destroy it during Who Dares Wins.

itm_00004331.summary: Pulse Grenade is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 1, value 40 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The pulse grenade is a weapon that creates a large crackling electromagnetic pulse, dealing only minor damage to biological creatures, but far more damage to mechanical targets such as robots and automated turrets. In addition, most robots are disabled for a few seconds by the burst, leaving them open to attack.

Thrown grenades are affected by physics; they may bounce or roll unexpectedly if not thrown carefully. However, in-game physics can also be used to one's advantage by throwing grenades through doorways or bouncing them around corners to attack enemies, while remaining undetected.

Grenades can be targeted in V.A.T.S. and can thus be shot out of the air. Grenades can also be shot and detonated while they are held by an enemy.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Talon Company mercenaries and Regulators sometimes carry pulse grenades with them.
• Can sometimes be bought from weapons merchants, such as Harith and Flak 'N Shrapnel's.
• Grenade boxes have a chance to contain two or three pulse grenades.
• One pulse grenade can be stolen from the Capitol Preservation Society. It is sitting next to the doghouse with a frag grenade.
• Four can be found in the Evergreen Mills bazaar. There is a bar to the immediate right of the entrance with two side-by-side refrigerators. Jump up on the shelves to look behind the refrigerators, they're in a small crate.
• Three in Fort Constantine's bomb storage.
• One can be found in the Preservation shelter outside the flooded metro.
• One can be found on L.O.B.

itm_00004330.summary: Frag Grenade is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 1, value 25 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
Frag grenades are standard grenades creating an explosive blast and dealing significant damage, with a high chance to cripple limbs. They are commonly used by melee-equipped raiders and super mutants when they are out of melee range.

Thrown grenades are affected by physics, they may bounce or roll unexpectedly if not thrown carefully. However, in-game physics can also be used to an advantage, such as throwing grenades through doorways or bouncing them around corners to ambush enemies out of sight.

Grenades are an optional target in V.A.T.S., and can even be shot out of the air, causing them to detonate. This can be used to an advantage, as they will deal damage to an enemy if they are holding them or in proximity when they explode.

sections.title: Variant
sections.text: • Sim version FO3OA - A version used exclusively in the Anchorage Reclamation simulation.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
Regular grenades:
• Used by super mutants and Brotherhood soldiers.
• Eulogy Jones, Robert and Sydney carry a grenade.
• Leroy Walker carries two grenades.
• Most slavers at the Lincoln Memorial carry a grenade.
• Carried by caravan guards.
• Three in the Arlington Library media archive.
• One on a table in the Arlington sewer.
• Two on a ledge in Bethesda Offices West, to the west.
• Five in Bethesda underworks, in a storage room.
• Five on a shelf in a small room to the south of Bethesda underworks's entrance (circle around).
• One in Brandice's house, on the floor next to a desk with a terminal.
• Two in the Citadel bailey, on the ground.
• Three in the Capitol Building, west entrance.
• Two on a table behind a rigged terminal in the Capitol Post.
• One in the Capitol Preservation Society in Rivet City, next to a doghouse.

itm_0000432e.summary: Gatling Laser is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 8, uses Electron Charge Pack, value 2000 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The Gatling laser is the most advanced weapon type for the Big Guns skill. It is similar to the minigun, however, the Gatling laser is actually not a Gatling weapon, as the barrels do not rotate when it fires - instead, the barrels fire in a rotating order. However, although the animation for this firing makes it appear very random and haphazard, the barrels do not have to 'wind-up' like the minigun, making the Gatling laser much easier and quicker to use. Gatling laser and its variants are some of the few weapons in-game capable of shooting down vertibirds.

One can easily take out any threat at a safe distance with a Gatling laser. At long range, it is actually an incredibly accurate weapon, though it performs poorly in V.A.T.S.

At point-blank range, it actually aims a bit lower than the cross-hair.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Vengeance - A unique variant that is more powerful but less durable.
• Precision Gatling laser FO3BS - While not as powerful as Vengeance, the precision Gatling laser has a very high critical multiplier of 0.2.
• Fawkes' Gatling laser - A unique, non-player version of the Gatling laser used by Fawkes after the end of The American Dream quest.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Gatling lasers are most commonly found on Enclave, Brotherhood Outcasts and Brotherhood of Steel soldiers. These soldiers can be found in areas like the Washington Monument, Fort Independence, inside Arlington Library, Pennsylvania Avenue and outside of the Citadel.
• Defender Rockfowl will often carry one.
• Inside Raven Rock, there is a Gatling laser in an Enclave crate behind a blue energy shield as the player character is leaving Raven Rock after one has spoken with President Eden. One will notice it on the right as they near the sentry bots which fight off three Enclave soldiers, just before the final door (leading to the Capital Wasteland). Deactivate the shield with the computer and the Gatling laser can be found in one of the five crates. There is a random chance to obtain a second Gatling laser in this location.

itm_0000432d.summary: The flamer is a weapon that projects an ignited stream of flammable liquid, and is classified as a big gun in Fallout 3.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The flamer is by far the most effective big gun for close-quarters action. The flamer and its ammunition are fairly common, and can be found on any Mister Gutsy (and even Mister Handies) as well as in many stores.

Durability:
The flamer can shoot a total of about 2500 units of flamer fuel, the equivalent of around 41 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Burnmaster - found in the Franklin Metro utility. Most powerful flamer variant.
• Rapid-torch flamer FO3BS - located in the Adams storage facility.
• Slo-burn flamer FO3BS - found on the upper level of the southeast portion of Launch Platform Base inside the Enclave mobile platform.
• Sim version FO3OA - A sim-only version of the flamer. It has 999,200 hit points, essentially preventing it from ever degrading.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• If the Lone Wanderer betrayed Sydney during the quest Stealing Independence, she will send Emaline against them, who will have a flamer equipped.
• The raider Torcher uses a flamer as his signature weapon.
• One is wielded by a respawning raider at the raid shack and the Bethesda ruins. Both raiders reappear every 72 hours.
• The Brotherhood of Steel initiate located in the Taft Tunnel wields one.
• Occasionally carried by Knight Sergeant Wilks.
• FO3OA In the Outcast outpost's armory, after the completion of the Operation: Anchorage add-on.
• FO3TP Two can be found in the Pitt steelyard in the supply plant, along with a small amount of flamer fuel.

itm_0000432c.summary: Fat Man is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 10, uses Mini Nuke, value 1000 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The Fat Man is a pre-War weapon that launches mini nukes. The mini nuke projectile is very heavy, and if simply fired straight ahead, it will travel only a short distance before falling to the ground and detonating (causing one to be caught well within the very damaging mini-nuclear blast). For optimal range, the Fat Man should be fired in V.A.T.S. mode at high skill levels (which automatically compensates for the projectile's downward trajectory), or at an upward angle to catapult the mini nuke further, so that it impacts at a safer distance.

The Fat Man has an estimated range of 150+ yards. The blast zone will be irradiated for a short time after detonation, giving out up to 8 rads per second.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Experimental MIRV - An incredibly destructive weapon, the MIRV fires eight mini nukes in a single shot.
• FO3OA Sim version - A sim-only version of the weapon, which has the same health.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• The Capitol Building - During or after the fight with the super mutant behemoth. One of the Talon mercs is armed with it, as well as a single mini nuke.
• Evergreen Mills - At the top of the foundry in a locked room.
• Fort Bannister - In the main Fort Bannister building in an Average locked room at the bottom of the concrete stairs.
• Fort Constantine - Along with two mini nukes. One will need all three of the special keys from the You Gotta Shoot 'Em in the Head quest to access the room.
• GNR building plaza - On a dead Brotherhood soldier with eight mini nukes, during the quest Following in His Footsteps. The corpse of the Brotherhood soldier will not appear if the normal GNR quest is skipped and Sentinel Lyons is not encountered.
• Germantown Police HQ - In the basement armory in an Average locked closet near the firing range.

itm_0000432b.summary: Deathclaw Gauntlet is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 20, value 150 caps). Linked to quests: Not of This World.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
This is the strongest unarmed weapon in terms of damage. Attacks with this gauntlet disregard Damage Resistance from any type of armor and it has an x5 critical chance multiplier. With 5 or more Luck and the Ninja perk, this gauntlet will always score a critical hit.

Durability:
The deathclaw gauntlet can successfully strike about 600 times from full condition before breaking.

Crafting:
The deathclaw gauntlet is made out of a deathclaw's hand, a medical brace for extra structure, a leather belt to render the hand rigid (and as a handle for the user's hand) and wonderglue to hold it all together. Deathclaw gauntlet schematics are needed to build it.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Schematics can be obtained from Bannon in Rivet City after completing the unmarked quest Council Seat in his favor.
• FO3TP An already-crafted deathclaw gauntlet can be found on the body of John Bear, one of the Bear Brothers, after the second battle in The Hole.
• At the F. Scott Key Trail & Campground, there is a schematic inside a trailer next to a dead wastelander.
• Can be found in a unique type A random encounter: A wounded deathclaw stalking a wastelander. The wastelander carries deathclaw gauntlet schematics and is killed when one gets to him.

itm_00004328.summary: Tire Iron is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 6, value 40 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
This common weapon, often used by raiders, is not very strong compared to other melee weapons. Although not a highly damaging weapon, it has a fast attack speed, so many blows can be landed quickly. It can be repaired with other tire irons, and can be acquired easily throughout the wasteland.

Durability:
The tire iron can successfully strike about 667 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text: • Highwayman's Friend - A unique tire iron found in Canterbury Commons. Slightly more powerful than the regular tire iron, the Highwayman's Friend is also much more durable. However, it weighs two pounds more than its non-unique variant.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Two in My Megaton house.
• Two in the utility.
• Four in the Roosevelt Academy and Maintenance tunnel.
• Two in the Chryslus Building reception area.
• Two in Hamilton's hideaway.
• Two in the Red Racer factory's factory floor.

itm_00004327.summary: Combat Shotgun is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 55, uses 12-Gauge Shotgun Shell, value 200 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: This model of shotgun was deployed as a close assault fire team's primary weapon (supplemented with explosives, an N99 pistol and a power fist) during the Anchorage Reclamation, and many working units have been scavenged by raiders, slavers and Talon Company mercs in the Capital Wasteland.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The combat shotgun combines a large drum magazine with high close-range damage. The only drawback is the weapon's poor reliability, as the combat shotgun deteriorates quickly. The combat shotgun is not fully-automatic.

Durability:
The combat shotgun can fire a total of about 145 rounds, the equivalent of 13 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• The Terrible Shotgun - a unique variant of the combat shotgun carried by the raider merchant Smiling Jack. It has a higher damage output, but twice the weapon spread and is 3 pounds heavier.
• Charon's shotgun - a non-player character only version carried by Charon.
• FO3OA Sim version - A simulation-only version used exclusively during the Anchorage Reclamation simulation with far more durability but otherwise identical stats.
• FO3BS Grenade launcher - a test weapon created for a G.E.C.K. tutorial. It uses shotgun shells but instead fires frag grenades as projectiles.

itm_00004326.summary: Combat Knife is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 7, value 50 caps). Linked to quests: Protecting the Water Way.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The military issue combat knife is a rather common melee weapon in Fallout 3. It is affected by the melee damage bonus from Strength. It is one of the better low-level melee weapons, and can get around 3-4 strikes in V.A.T.S., even with a reasonable number of AP and a fast swing speed outside of V.A.T.S. However, it has extremely short reach, about that of an unarmed weapon. With 10 Luck, it becomes an extremely potent weapon that will critically hit almost once every 4 to 5 hits.

The combat knife itself has a single edge with a clipped point, with a serrated edge on the back. It is of the standard Bowie shape.

The combat knife has the highest value-to-weight ratio of any non-unique melee weapon in the game.

Durability:
The combat knife can successfully strike about 1286 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Occam's Razor - A slightly stronger version of the combat knife, wielded by Talon Commander Jabsco.
• Stabhappy - Stabhappy shares all of its stats with Occam's Razor, but has two principle differences. Firstly, the raider that holds it respawns, allowing multiple copies to be obtained. Secondly, it deals an additional 50% damage to limbs.
• Charon's combat knife - A unique, non-playable version used by Charon with identical stats to the regular version.
• Trench knife FO3OA - The trench knife's stats are identical to the regular combat knife. The only difference is a unique "knuckle-duster" skin.
• Sim version combat knife FO3OA - A sim-only version of the weapon which differs only in health (essentially non-degrading).

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Combat knives are found on random raiders and Talon Company mercs across the Wastelands.
• Eight combat knives may be found in the Regulator HQ.
• Four in the National Guard depot's armory.
• Three in Wheaton Armory.
• Three are found in the Smith's basement as well as the garden shed in Andale.
• Three in Dominic and Machete's house.
• Three in Lock and Load in Paradise Falls.
• One can be found at Flak 'N Shrapnel's in the Rivet City market.
• One can be found in the Springvale school kitchen, next to a dead mole rat.
• Common loot in containers across the Capital Wasteland.
• Common loot found on wastelanders.
• FO3BS Thirteen combat knives in perfect condition can be found in the mobile base crawler's kitchen, middle deck.

itm_00004325.summary: Chinese Pistol is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 4, uses 10mm Round, value 190 caps). Linked to quests: The Waters of Life.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
An autoloading hand-held pistol fed by an internal magazine which is reloaded by 10-round stripper clips. It has one of the comparatively lowest damage ratings in the game, inferior even to the starting 10mm pistol.

While typically found on less-organized raiders and slavers, the weapon may also be carried by Talon Company mercenaries as a backup weapon. Even Megaton settlers and Underworld residents may carry it as a sidearm, though the 10mm pistol is a lot more commonplace, largely reducing the Chinese pistol's use to a curiosity for selling off to vendors.

Durability:
The Chinese pistol can fire a total of about 1250 rounds, the equivalent of 125 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Zhu-Rong v418 Chinese pistol - a unique variant with better critical chance and durability that deals fire damage over time.
• FO3OA - a simulated variant found only in the Anchorage Reclamation simulation.
• FO3OA - a cut unique variant with identical stats to the standard version while having the same appearance as the simulation version of the weapon. It is not used anywhere within the add-on and can only be acquired through the use of console commands.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Republic of Dave - One can be found in the Museum of Dave, though it must be stolen.
• Ahzrukhal, Alejandra Torres, Flak, Jabsco, Rosie, Sister, and Zimmer all carry the Chinese pistol.
• Raiders throughout the wasteland often carry them, but less commonly at higher levels.
• Traders usually have one or two Chinese pistols in their inventory, those includes vendors that may not specialize in selling weapons.
• They are sometimes found in locked safes.
• One on a conveyor belt in the Sewer waystation, near a teddy bear.
• Regulators sometimes carry one.
• FO3MZ Cryo lab - One can be found in a storage room here, on a table surrounded by other wasteland objects.

itm_00004324.summary: Brass Knuckles is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 6, value 20 caps). Linked to quests: Not of This World.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
A simple, low-level, unarmed weapon.

Durability:
Brass knuckles can successfully strike about 667 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• FO3TP Steel knuckles - Slightly stronger than the regular brass knuckles, the steel knuckles only use 14 AP per V.A.T.S. swing.
• cut Love Tap - A variant of the regular knuckles that was cut from the base game.
• Spiked knuckles - A variant of knuckles with spikes affixed.
• Plunkett's Valid Points - A unique variant of spiked knuckles found on Plunkett.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Commonly found on raiders.
• Sold by various merchants.
• FO3PL Occasionally carried by smugglers.

itm_00004323.summary: BB Gun is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 4, uses BB, value 36 caps). Linked to quests: Escape!.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
This gun is one of the weakest weapons in the game, with a base damage of only 4.

Durability:
The BB gun can fire a total of about 417 BBs, the equivalent of 5 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• The version received on the Lone Wanderer's 10th birthday is different than the standard BB gun. It has higher item health (1,000), a much faster rate of fire, no chance for a Critical Hit, and does not degrade with use. It is also a quest item, meaning that it cannot be dropped. There is no way to obtain this version of the weapon outside of Growing Up Fast, except through the use of console commands.
• Black Bart's Bane - A unique BB gun that was cut from the final game.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Found in the Lone Wanderer's room during the quest Escape!
• Bailey's Crossroads Metro - On the lower level of the metro, there is a gun with 75 BBs at the makeshift range.
• Big Town - In the possession of Kimba.
• Dukov's Place - A gun (but no ammunition) can be found on the second floor in the southern corridor.
• Evergreen Mills - A gun may be bought from Smiling Jack.
• Megaton - Sometimes sold by Moira Brown.
• Tenpenny Tower - One can be bought from Chief Gustavo, the security chief.
• VAPL-58 power station - On the roof along with 13-22 BBs.
• Northwest from the scrapyard, there is a power station. The first power pylon south of it (near a skeleton in a chair) has a gun and around 10 BBs, as well as a Nuka-Cola Quantum.
• Available for purchase at most gun stores.

itm_00004322.summary: Alien Blaster is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 100, uses Alien Power Cell, value 500 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: This rusty energy weapon is of extraterrestrial origin and was owned by Theta's pilot.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
It is one of the most powerful weapons in the game due to a critical hit being guaranteed. This weapon will be able to take down most foes with a single shot to the head.

This weapon also has the effect of disintegrating any enemy killed with a critical hit, identical to a laser weapon (with the difference that the disintegration effect is colored blue instead of red).

Durability:
The alien blaster can fire a total of around 125 shots, equivalent to 13 reloads, from full condition before breaking but will not jam until approximately 120 shots.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Firelance - Harder to obtain, yet slightly weaker than the blaster; the Firelance causes fire damage if the target survives the initial blast. This weapon is affected by the Pyromaniac perk.
• FO3MZ Captain's Sidearm - A unique, cleaner and shinier variant of the alien blaster which uses alien power modules. It is wielded by the alien captain.

itm_00004321.summary: 10mm Submachine Gun is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 7, uses 10mm Round, value 330 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
10mm ammo for the weapon is one of the most plentiful in the game and the SMG is also quite common, making it easy to repair. However, it suffers from poor accuracy due a high spread, making it ineffective at longer ranges.

Durability:
The 10mm SMG can fire a total of about 1190 times, the equivalent of 40 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Sydney's 10mm "Ultra" SMG - Relic hunter Sydney's weapon of choice, the Ultra SMG holds an astounding 50 10mm rounds in a single magazine, and deals more damage than the standard SMG.
• FO3OA Sim version - A sim-only version of the weapon which differs only in health, with a whopping 999,250 hit points, which essentially prevents the gun from ever degrading, well over 1500 rounds of ammunition can be fired without it degrading 1%. It can be obtained in the sim through certain equipment packs on the equipment terminal.
• cut 10mm Alloy Steel Submachinegun - Another version of the weapon was cut from the Operation: Anchorage add-on. Called the 10mm Alloy Steel Submachinegun, it is otherwise identical to the standard 10mm SMG.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Three in Fort Constantine's bomb storage, behind a Very Hard locked door.
• There are many SMGs in the National Guard depot in low condition.
• Several SMGs can be found inside the L.O.B. Enterprises building in low condition. There's one in the main floor's cafeteria, one on a box in the East Wing, and several in the Archives section.
• Rivet City security exclusively carry 10mm SMGs.
• Occasionally carried by Brotherhood paladins and knights, as well as Brotherhood Outcasts.
• Many slavers carry this weapon. They can be found at the Lincoln Memorial or Paradise Falls.
• Raiders may sometimes be armed with an SMG (especially at higher levels).
• Doc Hoff, Dukov, the child slaver, Michael Masters, Murphy and Robert all carry a 10mm SMG.
• Two on a table in a raider camp near the Tenleytown/Friendship station entrance.

itm_0000421c.summary: Baseball Bat is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 9, value 55 caps). Linked to quests: Escape!.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The baseball bat is a common melee weapon found in the wasteland. While useful for close combat with raiders, they are not particularly effective against the more durable foes found throughout the wasteland.

All things considered, Fallout 3's baseball bat is a decent melee weapon for early use and helps to preserve ammunition when starting out in the wasteland.

Durability:
The baseball bat can successfully strike about 889 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Curse Breaker - A unique baseball bat that was cut from the base game. If it is equipped on the PC version, it makes the player character disappear. This does not help with sneaking.
• Excalibat - Another cut baseball bat in the base game. The name "Excalibat" is a nod to the FPS Rise of the Triad: Dark War weapon of the same name.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Vault 101, during the beginning of Escape! It is in the Lone Wanderer's room, leaning on a desk with the BB gun and 50 BB pellets.
• If the Wasteland explorer theme is purchased for the player character's home in Megaton, a baseball bat will be included in the setup.
• In Minefield, near the mattress where Arkansas snipes at the player character.
• In Canterbury Commons, behind the counter next to the bed in Dot's Diner, there is one that when taken is not considered stealing.
• Inside the Anchorage Memorial inside the clinic on a shelf. It is lying next to a dead wastelander.
• There are a few propped up against the fence of the baseball field at Fordham Flash Memorial Field, along with other baseball equipment.
• Raiders sometimes carry one.
• In the north shack of Evergreen Mills.

itm_0000080b.summary: Chinese Assault Rifle is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 11, uses 5.56mm Round, value 500 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
A second-tier, general-purpose, automatic firearm chambered for 5.56mm ammunition, the weapon is the most powerful of the generic assault rifles in base damage and DPS. With a weapon spread of 1.5, it is a somewhat inaccurate weapon. It is the third least durable 5.56mm weapon. Regardless, it remains a formidable automatic weapon for any Small Guns character for the entire game.

FO3OA In the Operation: Anchorage add-on, certain weapons were re-skinned while one is in the Anchorage Reclamation simulation to make them look like actual pre-War weapons, with the Chinese assault rifle among the small group chosen for this. The new looks include brown-colored hand and foregrips, and the outer bluing is a darker black with fewer scratches than the post-War version.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Xuanlong assault rifle - a unique variant with a higher 36-round magazine and the highest damage of any automatic small gun.
• Jericho's Chinese assault rifle - a non-player variant used by Jericho.
• FO3OA Sim version - a variant only used while participating in the Anchorage Reclamation simulation, which differs only in health (essentially non-degrading). It also has a barely noticeable winterized color scheme on the stock and foregrip, and a much cleaner finish on the receiver and barrel.

• High damage - An additional variant with 1000 damage can also be found in Operation: Anchorage, used in the DLC02TrenchClimberTrig02SCRIPT and cannot be obtained under normal circumstances.
• Dragoon - a variant named Chinese Dragoon assault rifle can be found in the data files for Operation: Anchorage.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Lucas Simms carries one.
• Three can be found in the Megaton armory; must be stolen.
• Alejandra Torres, Bill Seward and Hannibal Hamlin all carry the Chinese assault rifle after siding with the slaves in the quest Head of State.
• Talon Company mercs and Regulators will begin to carry these at medium player levels.
• Four Chinese assault rifles can be found near dead Talon Company mercs in Metro Central along with another laying next to a skeleton in the men's restroom near the Pennsylvania Avenue exit.
• A majority of Chinese remnant soldiers in Mama Dolce's carries one.
• Super mutant masters often use this weapon.
• Two are sold at Flak 'N Shrapnel's, early in the game, that do not restock. At higher levels, they are stocked regularly.
• One can be found in Hallowed Moors Cemetery, north of Big Town.

itm_0000080a.summary: .32 Pistol is a weapon in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (Damage 6, uses .32 Caliber Round, value 110 caps). Linked to quests: The Waters of Life.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
A low-caliber handgun produced by the pre-War Smith & Wesson and chambered for.32 caliber rounds, the weapon is commonly used by raiders and wastelanders alike in the Capital Wasteland. It comparatively deals little damage per shot next to other weapons and its cylinder has a capacity of five rounds.

Durability:
The.32 pistol can fire a total of about 556 standard rounds, the equivalent of 112 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• FO3TP Wild Bill's Sidearm - A unique variant that is more powerful and durable.
• FO3TP Concealed.32 pistol - A variant classified as a miscellaneous item that can be optionally given by Wernher during Into The Pitt if one decides to try sneaking a weapon past the raiders and asks for a gun. It is replaced by a normal.32 pistol after completing the quest.
• cut Law Dog - A unique variant that was cut from the base game.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Big Town - Flash and Timebomb will always be wielding one. Also, Shorty will have this weapon if the Small Guns path of the quest Big Trouble in Big Town is followed.
• James is equipped with one after exiting Tranquility Lane, and two can be found inside Project Purity, one in the gift shop, and another in the basement sub-levels.
• Hubris Comics - One can be found in the building, under a table in a dead man's hand, implying he committed suicide. There is a Nuka-Cola vending machine, whiskey, and Quantum right next to it, which help in locating it.
• Megaton - Jenny Stahl carries one.
• Minefield - One can be found near the mattress in the building where Arkansas snipes from.
• National Guard depot bunker - One can be found on a wooden shelf, next to a box of 5 bullets for it.

itm_000615af.summary: Electron Charge Pack is a ammunition in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 1 caps). Linked to quests: The American Dream.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
This type of ammunition is considered one of the rarest ammunitions in the game and is used by big guns and one energy weapon.

Weapons using this ammunition:
• Gatling laser
• Vengeance
• FO3BS Tesla cannon
• FO3BS Precision Gatling laser

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
The electron charge pack is very rare at lower levels, but it can be found in a few places. Acquiring the Scrounger perk makes this ammunition much more plentiful. The amount of electron charge pack ammunition found will most likely depend on the type of character encountered:
• Sentry bots that have a Gatling laser weapon often carry a few rounds.
• Merchants occasionally stock up on the ammunition type. Like 5mm rounds, they normally have many in their inventory at one time.
• Enclave, Brotherhood of Steel, and Outcasts occasionally carry a Gatling laser, as well as the ammunition for it.

There are several locations that will always hold an electron charge pack:
• One in Evergreen Mills Foundry, on a table with a radio.

itm_0006b53d.summary: 5mm Round is a ammunition in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 1 caps). Linked to quests: Reilly's Rangers.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: 5mm rounds are used by the high capacity minigun, which loads 240 rounds at once and fires them rapidly. They are typically sold in higher quantities and found in higher quantities compared to other ammunitions.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Often carried by super mutants, especially brutes and masters.
• Members of the Brotherhood of Steel tend to carry miniguns along with a small quantity of 5mm ammo.
• Lucky Harith carries this ammunition (up to 1000 rounds) when fully invested in.
• FO3TP Found in abundance throughout the Pitt.

itm_0006a80d.summary: Mesmetron Power Cell is a ammunition in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 10 caps). Linked to quests: Strictly Business.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The Mesmetron power cell, as the name suggests, is used only by the Mesmetron. It is virtually the same in appearance as energy cells, but the negative terminals are capped with blue coloring instead of yellow.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Grouse in Paradise Falls has fifty cells which the Lone Wanderer receives at the same time as the Mesmetron. Grouse will also sell more cells at the price of 200 caps per 10 cells.
• FO3PL A total of 76 extra cells, typically in stacks of five, are available in the St. Aubin Medical Facility, the underground lair of Professor Calvert's brain.

sections.title: Related quests
sections.text:
• Strictly Business
• Strictly Profitable

itm_0002937e.summary: .44 Round, Magnum is a ammunition in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 2 caps). Linked to quests: Reilly's Rangers.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: Very few enemies carry weapons that use this ammunition, and as such it is rarely found on bodies and must be either purchased or looted from stockpiles, where it is still uncommon. Even with the Scrounger perk,.44 Magnum ammunition still remains less common than 10mm or.32 caliber ammunition. However, significant caches can be found, drastically improving the usefulness of those powerful weapons. Because it is uncommon in the Capital Wasteland and it has high stopping power,.44 Magnum round is more expensive than any pistol caliber ammunition.

sections.title: Weapons using this ammunition
sections.text:
• Scoped.44 Magnum
• Lincoln's repeater
• Blackhawk
• Mysterious Stranger's.44 Magnum (console command only)
• FO3BS Callahan's Magnum
• FO3MZ Paulson's revolver

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Random ammunition boxes might have this ammo type.

Merchants:
Several merchants will frequently have large quantities of.44 Magnum ammunition in stock (10, 15, even 20+):
• Chief Gustavo in Tenpenny Tower.
• Flak 'N Shrapnel's in Rivet City.
• Sydney after completion with her as a companion in the Stealing Independence quest.
• Lucky Harith, the caravan merchant dealing in weapons (after merchandise upgrades at Canterbury Commons).
• Smiling Jack in Evergreen Mills.
• Tulip in Underworld.
• Knight Captain Durga in the Citadel.
• Moira Brown in Megaton.
• Knick Knack in Little Lamplight.
• Michael Masters in Tenpenny Tower after helping the ghouls move into the tower.
• Pronto in Paradise Falls, after bringing him 20 Chinese assault rifles.
• Seagrave Holmes in Rivet City.
• Lydia Montenegro in Tenpenny tower.

itm_0002935b.summary: BB is a ammunition in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 1 caps). Linked to quests: Escape!, Growing Up Fast.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The Enforcer BB ammo is used in only one weapon, the BB gun.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• On top of the VAPL-58 power station are a BB gun and three ammunition containers.
• Northwest of the scrapyard, there is a power station. The first power pylon south of it has a BB gun and two ammunition containers.
• An unlimited amount of BBs can be obtained from James at the "shooting range" during Growing Up Fast; however, only 50 can be obtained during Escape! in the Lone Wanderer's room.
• FO3PL Over 100 on the shelf to the right of the entrance to Haley's Hardware.
• FO3MZ 300 rounds on the assembly line of the cargo hold of Mothership Zeta.

Can be bought from:
• Flak 'N Shrapnel's in Rivet City.
• Knight Captain Durga in the Citadel.
• Smiling Jack in the Evergreen Mills bazaar.
• Tulip at Underworld.
• Chief Gustavo in Tenpenny Tower.
• FO3PL Haley at Haley's Hardware.

itm_00028eea.summary: Shotgun Shell is a ammunition in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 2 caps). Linked to quests: Among the Stars, Companion Recruitment: Charon.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The Buckslayer brand shotgun shell is common in the Capital Wasteland, as they are carried by all enemies that use any shotgun weapon.

sections.title: Weapons using this ammunition
sections.text:
• Combat shotgun
• The Terrible Shotgun
• Sawed-off shotgun
• The Kneecapper
• Double-barrel shotgun FO3PL
• Pa's Fishing Aid FO3PL
• Charon's shotgun

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Can be found mostly in filing cabinets, gore bags, ammo boxes, and Enclave crates, and, in rare cases, desks, especially with the Scrounger perk.
• Most merchants have a good supply of shells.
• In the Evergreen Mills bazaar, Smiling Jack will have around 70 of them in his inventory, which can be stolen with no Karma loss.
• Four ammo boxes in the Dickerson Tabernacle Chapel.
• Three boxes in the yao guai tunnels, in/near a bookcase just to the left of the main four-way crossing.

itm_000207f7.summary: .32 Caliber Round is a ammunition in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 1 caps). Linked to quests: Lincoln Artifacts.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
It is used with the.32 pistol, the hunting rifle and their unique variants. Generally speaking, the.32 round is the second most common Small Guns ammunition found in the game, behind 10mm rounds. After the Picking Up the Trail quest, it becomes less available as enemies start carrying assault rifles in place of hunting rifles.

These rounds are not particularly useful, as the.32 pistol is far weaker than the 10mm pistol the Lone Wanderer is given early in the game. The hunting rifle is eventually superseded by the sniper rifle, but as.308 caliber rounds are not as common and super mutants have a strong tendency to carry hunting rifles, it may be necessary to rely on.32 caliber rounds for long-range combat.

sections.title: Weapons using this ammunition
sections.text:
•.32 pistol
• FO3TP Wild Bill's Sidearm
• Hunting rifle
• Ol' Painless

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
•.32 caliber rounds can be found along with 5mm rounds and 5.56mm rounds anywhere super mutants tend to congregate, particularly in Washington, D.C. The abandoned Brotherhood of Steel bunker near the Washington Monument is a good spot to farm.32 ammunition, as a number of super mutants spawn here frequently, as is the GNR building plaza.
• James seems to like.32 pistols and has many of them and.32 caliber rounds lying around his outposts.
• Three ammunition boxes in the county sewer mainline, in the storage room, near the sewer management access terminal.
• Two boxes in the jack-knifed blue/white truck near the exploding scientist truck.
• Two boxes at the military checkpoint, just north of Smith Casey's garage.
• Two boxes in the Jury St. tunnels, in a passageway between two metro track lines in the south.

itm_00020799.summary: The mini nuke, or micro-nuke, is a small tactical nuclear warhead designed for use in a nuclear catapult weapon in Fallout 3.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: Mini nukes are the most expensive type of ammunition due to their rarity, ranging from 250 to 400 caps each, depending on the player's Barter skill. They are the ammunition for the two most powerful weapons in the game: the Fat Man and the experimental MIRV. The explosion when fired is powerful, causing a characteristic mushroom cloud and leaving residual radioactivity. The users themselves may absorb radiation if they are close to the projectile, even after detonation.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text: There are a total of 70 mini nukes found openly in the world. Two more can be obtained by doing various quests. Another two are in random encounters, one of which only occurs after completing the Reilly's Rangers quest. Another can be found in Operation: Anchorage, 13 in Broken Steel, eight in Point Lookout and two in Mothership Zeta, making for 98 in total with all add-ons.

itm_00004485.summary: Microfusion Cell is a ammunition in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 3 caps). Linked to quests: The Replicated Man, The Guns of Anchorage.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: A miniaturized fusion reactor, this ammunition is visually identical in size and shape to electron charge packs, though microfusion cells are yellow. It can be found throughout the Capital Wasteland and surrounding areas, and purchased from merchants.

sections.title: Weapons using this ammunition
sections.text:
• Laser rifle
• Wazer Wifle
• Plasma rifle
• A3-21's plasma rifle
• FO3OA Gauss rifle
• FO3TP Metal Blaster
• FO3BS Tri-beam laser rifle
• FO3PL Microwave emitter

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Merchants usually sell this ammunition type, such as Flak, Chief Gustavo, and Knight Captain Durga.
• Enclave soldiers, Brotherhood knights and paladins, and Brotherhood Outcasts usually use either a plasma rifle or laser rifle along with ammunition for it.
• 35 cells can be taken from toilet traps.
• Occasionally carried by Regulators and Talon Company mercs.
• 80 cells in Fort Independence's armory on the lower level.
• FO3OA 70 cells in the Outcast outpost's armory, after the completion of the Operation: Anchorage add-on.
• FO3MZ 80 cells on a table in the weapons lab.

itm_00004241.summary: 10mm Round is a ammunition in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 1 caps). Linked to quests: Escape!, Reilly's Rangers, Aiding the Outcasts.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: It is the most common type of ammunition in the Capital Wasteland, with the second most common being the.32 caliber round. The weapons that use such ammunition are also common, and there are many different types of guns with different statistics that use them, making 10mm rounds very useful. Made by Circle G, it comes in ammunition boxes of 12 rounds.

sections.title: Weapons using this ammunition
sections.text:
• 10mm pistol
• Silenced 10mm pistol
• Colonel Autumn's 10mm pistol
• Chinese pistol
• Zhu-Rong v418 Chinese pistol
• 10mm SMG
• Sydney's 10mm "Ultra" SMG
• FO3PL Lever-action rifle
• FO3PL Backwater rifle

• FO3OA Test gun

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Five ammunition boxes in Dr. Lesko's lab in Marigold station.
• Four boxes in a military truck in front of the National Guard depot.
• Three boxes at the abandoned car fort.
• Three boxes in Flak 'N Shrapnel's in the Rivet City market.
• Three boxes at Lock and Load in Paradise Falls.
• Three boxes in the northern shack in Evergreen Mills.
• Three boxes in the Super-Duper Mart, on the counter behind the terminal opening the storage room.

itm_00004240.summary: 5.56mm Round is a ammunition in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 1 caps). Linked to quests: Free Labor, Reilly's Rangers, The Guns of Anchorage.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: Relatively speaking, the 5.56mm round is the third most common Small Guns ammunition found in the game, compared to the.32 caliber and 10mm rounds. After The Waters of Life quest, the 5.56mm cartridge becomes more common as enemies will use assault rifles more often than hunting rifles chambered for.32 rounds. The 5.56mm ammo's world model is a black curved box magazine (resembling ones utilized by the Chinese assault rifle).

sections.title: Weapons using this ammunition
sections.text:
• R91 assault rifle
• Chinese assault rifle
• Xuanlong assault rifle
• FO3TP Infiltrator
• FO3TP Perforator

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
5.56mm rounds are typically found on raiders, Talon Company mercs and at super mutant camps. Areas to search include the ruins of Washington, D.C. and the Metro tunnels underneath the downtown area. Alternatively, large amounts of this ammunition can be acquired quickly through several means:
• At Fort Independence, Brotherhood Outcast Casdin will trade 5.56mm rounds in exchange for certain technological items.
• 14 magazines can be found spread throughout Metro Central; four of which will be near a female Talon Company merc behind a wrecked train in the waiting area.
• FO3TP Located in The Mill of The Pitt, the ammo press can be unlocked by completing the quest Free Labor, which allows the conversion of any ballistics-based firearm ammunition or scrap metal into any other types of ballistic firearm ammunition, including 5.56mm.

itm_0007cf72.summary: Tenpenny Resident's Key is a key in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 5 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Overview & Properties
sections.text: Item classification: Key from Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (EditorID: TenpennyResidentKey). Weight: 0.0, Value: 5 caps.

sections.title: Where to Find & Usage
sections.text: Carried or sold by: Susan Lancaster, Herbert "Daring" Dashwood, Michael Hawthorne, Edgar Wellington II, Millicent Wellington, Doctor Banfield.

itm_0007cf64.summary: Vera Weatherly's Room Key is a key in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 5 caps). Available across Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) locations and merchants.

sections.title: Overview & Properties
sections.text: Item classification: Key from Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (EditorID: VeraWeatherlyRoomKey). Weight: 0.0, Value: 5 caps.

sections.title: Where to Find & Usage
sections.text: Carried or sold by: Vera Weatherly. Obtained through exploration, containers, or quest progression in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland).

itm_000c9cf4.summary: Ultrajet is a aid / chems & food in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 50 caps). Linked to quests: Death From Above.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: Ultrajet immediately boosts the user's current Action Points by +40, as well as raising their maximum action points by the same amount for 4 minutes, and has a 20% chance of ultrajet addiction. Also, ultrajet use will not alleviate or cause jet addiction and vice versa.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text: The ghoul Murphy, located in Northwest Seneca Station, synthesizes and sells ultrajet. His supply is limited; he will only sell one ultrajet for every eight boxes of Sugar Bombs brought to him.

itm_000bf7c7.summary: Orange Mentats is a aid / chems & food in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 20 caps). Linked to quests: Death From Above.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: Mentats return in Fallout 3, though they only increase Intelligence and Perception, omitting the Charisma bonus. As in previous games, using them boosts skills based on those attributes (although not to skill points earned on level up, as Mentats do not alter base stats).

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
One of three different kinds of Mentats can be won in a quiz pertaining to the Declaration of Independence at the National Archives, these are:
• Berry Mentats grant a +5 to Intelligence
• Orange Mentats grant a +5 to Perception
• Grape Mentats grant a +5 to Charisma

Given that regular Mentats provide the same type and strength of bonuses as the Berry and Orange versions (and all in one package), practical-minded players may want to choose Grape Mentats when redeeming their prize vouchers. The unique +5 bonus to Charisma (and consequent +10 to Speech and Barter) may come in handy with difficult Speech checks or large bartering sessions.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text: Found at some raider and Enclave camps.

itm_00095f48.summary: NukaLurk Meat is a aid / chems & food in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 7 caps). Linked to quests: Death From Above.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: Nukalurk meat weighs 1 pound, has a base value of 7 caps, and when eaten gives the Lone Wanderer +5 Radiation, AP +10 and +20 Hit Points (24 HP with food sanitizer in the inventory). It glows the same blue as the Nuka-Cola Quantum bottles.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text: On Nukalurks, in the Nuka-Cola plant. It is only possible to acquire a maximum of 10, as that is the total number of Nukalurks in the factory. They do not respawn. Note that the Nukalurks drop the meat randomly, meaning that they may have an empty inventory instead of the meat.

itm_00085abb.summary: Fire Ant Nectar is a aid / chems & food in Fallout 3 (Capital Wasteland) (value 20 caps). Linked to quests: Death From Above.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
Ant nectar:
Ant nectar is a naturally occurring substance secreted by giant ants. The nectar raises the consumer's Strength exceptionally, but lowers their Intelligence and Charisma by a considerable amount.

Fire ant nectar:
Fire ant nectar is a naturally occurring substance secreted by fire ants. The nectar raises the consumer's Agility significantly, but also lowers their Intelligence an exceptional amount. The nectar also adds 25% to Fire Resistance upon consumption.

Ant queen pheromones:
Ant queen nectar is a strong aphrodisiac that raises the user's Charisma greatly at the cost of Intelligence and Perception. It can only be found on giant ant queens.
