We'll die today, but by God we'll give those Communist sonsabitches a black eye they'll never forget.

Lloyd out.

Holotape - Overrun:
Oh, Molly... I'm Sorry. I am so sorry.

I can't do this. I'm so afraid, Molly. I don't want to die. Oh my God, I don't want to die...

We held them as long as we could, I swear we did. Then Ciello asked for a magazine, and when I turned to give it to him, a shell hit, and...

He's gone, Molly. He was there one second, and then he wasn't. His blood... and, and... bits of him... Ohh... my God, he's all over me!

Please, please, please, let them leave, let them leave, let them leave. I just want to come home. I just want to be with you again.

I'm hiding now. The Chinese are everywhere. I'm a coward, I'm a coward I know. But I don't care.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
The first three of the holotapes can be found next to the corresponding intel suitcases that are needed to gain the Covert Ops perk.

The fourth can be found a little bit past the room with the fourth intel suitcase. Up the set of double stairs from the first shell storage room is a very easy locked door in a N/S corridor.

The fifth holotape is in the command tent where the setting switches to, after the end of the quest The Guns of Anchorage.

The sixth tape can be found in Doctor Adami's tent.

sections.title: Transcripts
sections.text:
Holotape - Bombardment:
Audio Log Begin.

This is Captain Zachary Lloyd, United States Army, Anchorage, Alaska security detachment!

We are approximately two hours into the Chinese assault on this outpost!

We are being shelled non-stop, indiscriminately! The entire base is under bombardment from the Chinese ships, and they don't care who they hit!

All accounts indicate they've actually killed more of their own men than ours! They just do not seem to care about their own troops, at all!

At this rate, the entire mountain will be a graveyard in less than an hour, and then the Chinese will just move in and set up shop!

God help us! God help America!

Holotape - Goodbye:
Molly, I hope this tape gets to you, someway somehow. I don't have a lot of time, but you need to know what happened to me.

The early reports weren't bullshit.

itm_0200b511.summary: Metal Master Armor is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 36.0, value 160 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
Metal Master armor is a variant of raider throwdown armor available in the Fallout 3 add-on The Pitt. Like the other throwdown armors, it is comprised of components from metal armor and raider sadist armor. Everett explains that the previous user made it bullet-proof, but it did not help him after he fell off of the bridge.

It is only repairable with leather armor, and provides a Damage Resistance of 36 as well as bonuses of 10 to Unarmed and Energy Weapons while incurring a penalty of -1 to Agility.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text: It is a reward for bringing 40 steel ingots to Foreman Everett.

itm_0200b510.summary: Bombshell Armor is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 24.0, value 160 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The Bombshell armor is a variant of raider ordinance armor. It can be repaired with leather armor and provides a Damage Resistance of 24 as well as bonuses of 10 to Big Guns and Explosives. The Bombshell armor weighs 5 pounds more than the regular ordinance armor, despite not being any different in appearance.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The armor is awarded by Foreman Everett in exchange for 60 steel ingots during the Mill Worker quest.

itm_0200b50f.summary: Tribal Power Armor is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 35.0, value 740 caps). Linked to quests: Into The Pitt.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: This armor is aesthetically identical to Ashur's power armor. Everett notes this as being intended by the armor's designers. Pitt natives came to see Ashur as a god and made this set of armor to emulate the way their god looked. It was one of the original suits of power armor worn by the Brotherhood of Steel. While they are identical in design, their effects vary.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
While the tribal power armor does subtract a single point of Agility, this only causes the player character to lose 2 AP. Because of the armor's bonus of 15 AP, this means a net gain of 13 AP.

This body armor has the greatest increase for AP (15), which stacks with Ledoux's hockey mask (+25 AP), for a total of +38 AP (two are lost from the Agility decrease), and can be combined with the stacking effects of Jet, Ultrajet and Nuka-Cola Quantum, for a grand total of +130 Action Points, making it one of the most useful choices for V.A.T.S.-centric player character builds.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: Given to the Lone Wanderer by Everett for finding all 100 steel ingots. He calls it the prize of his collection.

itm_0200b50e.summary: Leather Rebel is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 30.0, value 160 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: According to Everett, the armor previously belonged to an unnamed desert priest who boasted it was bulletproof, a theory which was proven false when put to the test, described by Everett as "a gloriously fun time". Everett then confiscated the armor and added it to his collection in the Steelyard.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The Leather Rebel is a variant of the raider commando armor, with higher Damage Resistance, similar weight, and similar durability, but a lower caps value. Additionally, despite being a variant of the raider commando armor, it is classified as leather armor and can only be repaired with that type.

While the raider commando armor grants +3 bonuses to Unarmed and Small Guns, the Leather Rebel grants a +1 bonus to Charisma.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The armor is located in the Steelyard and may be given by Everett after collecting 70 steel ingots during Mill Worker.

itm_0200b4b2.summary: Laborer Outfit is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 5.0, value 6 caps). Linked to quests: Unsafe Working Conditions.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: It is identical to the tattered slave outfit in looks and can be repaired with slave outfits as well as various wasteland outfits. It provides Damage Resistance of 5 and boosts Agility, Endurance, and Strength by one point each while only weighing two pounds.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: It can be received from Everett as the first reward for the Unsafe Working Conditions quest. It will be rewarded once ten steel ingots have been retrieved.

itm_0200b4b1.summary: The filtration helmet is a unique supervisor helmet added to Fallout 3 with the add-on The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: It can be repaired with supervisor helmets and provides a Damage Resistance of 5 as well as a bonus of 10 to Radiation Resistance.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The helmet is awarded by Everett after finding 20 steel ingots.

itm_0200a39d.summary: Raider Commando Armor is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 18.0, value 200 caps). Linked to quests: Into The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: Raider commando armor is a variant of the raider armor added to Fallout 3 with the add-on The Pitt. It resembles a trimmed-down leather armor and provides a Damage Resistance of 18 as well as bonuses of 3 to both Unarmed and Small Guns.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Worn by various Pitt raiders in the Pitt.
• Can be bought from Friday.

itm_0200a39b.summary: Raider Ordinance Armor is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 18.0, value 200 caps). Linked to quests: Into The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: Raider ordinance armor is a variant of the raider armor. The breast cups on the female model appear to be hollowed out mini nukes with the red tips removed or painted over, while the male variant has the back end of the mini nuke's stabilizer fins tied over their chest.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Worn by various Pitt raiders in the Pitt.
• Can be bought from Friday.

itm_0200a39a.summary: Raider Throwdown Armor is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 18.0, value 200 caps). Linked to quests: Into The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
Raider throwdown armor is a variant of the raider armor. It seems to resemble a trimmed-down metal armor. It provides a Damage Resistance of 18, as well as a bonus of 3 to both Unarmed and Melee Weapons.

It can be repaired using all variants of raider armor found in The Pitt, as well as raider armors from the Capital Wasteland.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• It can be found before entering the Pitt, during the first encounter with the Pitt raiders at the radio tower, as well as in the Pitt itself.
• Occasionally worn by Everett.
• Can be bought from Friday.

itm_0200a398.summary: Raider Paingiver Armor is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 18.0, value 200 caps). Linked to quests: Into The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
Raider paingiver armor is a variant of the raider armor. It provides 3 additional points of Damage Resistance protection compared to standard raider armor, while also weighing 10 pounds less, being the lightest raider armor in the game. It also provides a bonus of 4 to Unarmed. It is the most bare-bones raider armor permutation, consisting solely of a set of leather pants. The armor version for females is a belly shirt tank top with the same pants.

It can be repaired using all raider armors found in the Pitt, as well as raider armors from the Capital Wasteland.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Worn by various Pitt raiders in the Pitt.
• Can be bought from Friday.

itm_02009ac1.summary:
The tattered outfits and worn slave outfits are pieces of clothing worn by Pitt slaves in the Fallout 3 add-on The Pitt.

They can be repaired with other copies of themselves, or by obtaining one of the various wasteland outfits (see infobox), in which they provide a Damage Resistance of 2, as well as bonuses of 1 to Agility and Endurance.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
Tattered slave outfit:
The tattered slave outfit can be obtained at the beginning of The Pitt, from a slave named Prosper. The add-on gives the choice of either obtaining it from a dead slave in the slave pen located at the train tunnel, or by requesting one from Prosper himself. If worn, when meeting Mex at The Pitt entrance, he will mistake the Lone Wanderer for a slave.

Worn slave outfit:
The worn slave outfit is identical to the tattered one, with the only difference being that is a dark brown color.

Unique variants:
• Laborer outfit

sections.title: Overview & Properties
sections.text: Item classification: Armor / Apparel from The Pitt (EditorID: DLC01SlaveOutfit2). Weight: 2.0, Value: 6 caps. Effects: Endurance +1, Agility +1.

sections.title: Where to Find & Usage
sections.text: Used in quests: Into The Pitt. Obtained through exploration, containers, or quest progression in The Pitt.

itm_02009383.summary: Gamma shield armor is a variant of metal armor found in the Fallout 3 add-on The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: It can be repaired with metal armor and provides a Damage Resistance of 36 as well as increasing Radiation Resistance by 15% while reducing Agility by 1.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
A total of five suits of gamma shield armor may be found:
• Gruber and John Bear each wear a set.
• Two wildmen each have one, located in the supply plant and another one near Wild Bill's corpse.
• One can be found on a dead Pitt raider in an irradiated area to the left of the entrance to the steelyard while facing away from the door.
In addition, some of the Pitt raiders attacking Wernher at the radio tower may be wearing a set.

itm_02008b8a.summary: Welder's Mask is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 5.0, value 20 caps). Linked to quests: Into The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: It is a variant of the raider arclight helmet featuring an increased Damage Resistance of 5. It can be repaired with raider arclight helmets.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: It can be found on a number of slaves in the Pitt.

itm_02007fc5.summary: The supervisor helmet is a piece of headwear worn by Pitt raiders in the Fallout 3 add-on The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: It can be repaired with other supervisor helmets and provides a Damage Resistance of 5. It appears to consist of a gas mask and a hard hat fitted with a headlamp.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
It can be found in several areas, such as on a Pitt raider positioned outside where Ashur usually stands (it can be acquired from him through killing him or reverse-pickpocketing better equipment).

It may also be bought from Friday, a vendor in the Downtown section of The Pitt, or looted from Pitt raiders during the fights in The Hole or the slave uprising.

itm_02006852.summary: Ashur's power armor is a unique set of T-45d power armor in the Fallout 3 add-on The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: Through years of misuse, makeshift repairs, scarcity of materials, and constant use, it is a rusty, highly stylized suit of power armor. The left arm of the suit was replaced with the sleeve and glove of the raider iconoclast armor, a brahmin skull substituted for the left pauldron, an icon of a skull strapped to the codpiece, and various bits and pieces of metal were used to patch holes in the structure of it. This power armor suit was originally issued to Ishmael Ashur by the Brotherhood of Steel before he was assumed to be dead and left behind in the Pitt.

sections.title: Statistics
sections.text: The following is a comparison of Ashur's power armor and the tribal power armor.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: This suit of armor is only worn by Ashur. He can be looted of it at the end of Free Labor, or by reverse-pickpocketing any well-repaired suit of power armor and taking it from him once he equips the new armor. It can also be taken without repercussions toward Pitt raiders by hacking the Mk V turret's control terminal, with 75 Science required.

itm_020032dd.summary: Raider Iconoclast Armor is a armor / apparel in The Pitt (DR 18.0, value 200 caps). Linked to quests: Into The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: Raider iconoclast armor is a variant of the raider armor.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Raider iconoclast armors are worn by various Pitt raiders in the Pitt.
• Grudd Bear appears in the Hole during Unsafe Working Conditions while wearing the armor. It can be taken from his body after killing him.
• They are sold by Friday.

itm_0200087a.summary:
The tattered outfits and worn slave outfits are pieces of clothing worn by Pitt slaves in the Fallout 3 add-on The Pitt.

They can be repaired with other copies of themselves, or by obtaining one of the various wasteland outfits (see infobox), in which they provide a Damage Resistance of 2, as well as bonuses of 1 to Agility and Endurance.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
Tattered slave outfit:
The tattered slave outfit can be obtained at the beginning of The Pitt, from a slave named Prosper. The add-on gives the choice of either obtaining it from a dead slave in the slave pen located at the train tunnel, or by requesting one from Prosper himself. If worn, when meeting Mex at The Pitt entrance, he will mistake the Lone Wanderer for a slave.

Worn slave outfit:
The worn slave outfit is identical to the tattered one, with the only difference being that is a dark brown color.

Unique variants:
• Laborer outfit

sections.title: Overview & Properties
sections.text: Item classification: Armor / Apparel from The Pitt (EditorID: DLC01SlaveOutfit). Weight: 2.0, Value: 6 caps. Effects: Endurance +1, Agility +1.

sections.title: Where to Find & Usage
sections.text: Used in quests: Unsafe Working Conditions, Into The Pitt.

itm_0200a829.summary: Concealed .32 Pistol is a misc / quest item in The Pitt (value 0 caps). Linked to quests: Into The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The concealed.32 pistol is a regular.32 pistol hidden on the body so it is not found during a search. It is given to the Lone Wanderer by Wernher during Into the Pitt, when he gives them the choice between trying to sneak a pistol or a knife past the gate guards. If the pistol is chosen, the concealed.32 pistol is automatically added to the inventory in the Misc tab. It cannot be used at this point, but after the confiscation of the player's equipment while entering the Pitt the concealed.32 pistol will be removed from the inventory. A.32 pistol in poor condition and.32 caliber rounds will then be added to the inventory.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
•.32 pistol - The standard variant.
• FO3TP Wild Bill's Sidearm - A unique variant that is more powerful and durable. Found on Wild Bill's body.
• Cut Law Dog - A unique variant of the.32 pistol that was cut from the base game.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: Given to the player by Wernher if the relevant dialogue option is chosen before leaving the train yard for the first time during Into The Pitt.

itm_0200a828.summary: Concealed Switchblade is a misc / quest item in The Pitt (value 0 caps). Linked to quests: Into The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The concealed switchblade is a regular switchblade hidden on the body so it is not found during a search. It is given to the Lone Wanderer by Wernher during Into the Pitt, when he gives them the choice between trying to sneak a pistol or a knife past the gate guards. If the knife is picked, the concealed switchblade is automatically added to the inventory in the Misc tab. It cannot be used at this point, but after the confiscation of the player's equipment while entering the Pitt the concealed switchblade will be removed from the inventory and a switchblade in poor condition will be added.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: Given to the player by Wernher if the relevant dialogue option is chosen before leaving the train yard for the first time during Into The Pitt.

itm_02005fbb.summary: Wernher's Note to Midea is a misc / quest item in The Pitt (value 1 caps). Linked to quests: Free Labor.

sections.title: Overview & Properties
sections.text: Item classification: Misc / Quest Item from The Pitt (EditorID: DLC01MideaNoteItem). Weight: 0.0, Value: 1 caps.

sections.title: Where to Find & Usage
sections.text: Found at locations: Midea's Quarters. Used in quests: Free Labor.

itm_020032de.summary: Steel Ingot is a misc / quest item in The Pitt (value 1 caps). Linked to quests: Unsafe Working Conditions.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
High grade ingots made of industrial-strength steel that were forged before the Great War in the mills located in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

Following the nuclear apocalypse, in the intervening years before 2277, a large number of them were scattered throughout the grounds of the now-defunct Steelyard that produced them. These ingots became highly sought after by the raiders under Lord Ashur, due to their superior quality compared to the steel produced by the slaves working in the still-active mills.

The raiders regularly force the non-working slaves to enter the steelyard to try and retrieve any ingots they can find, and occasionally the raiders themselves will attempt to find them, however, the heavy infestation of trogs and Wildmen in the steelyard make traversing unprepared, as most slaves do, a death sentence.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
Steelyard:
There are 79 steel ingots in the Pitt steelyard.

Supply plant:
There are 18 steel ingots in the supply plant.

Abandoned area:
There are three steel ingots in the abandoned area.

Steelyard (79):
- (2/2) The first 2 ingots are next to the dead slave immediately upon entering the steelyard.
- (2/4) There are 2 in the first large dumpster to the left by the trailer with the couch on top of it. There are three large dumpsters. Access this dumpster by jumping over from the roof of the truck. It is also possible to move along the ledge outside the fence to the left of the truck, around the corner, and then jump across.
- (2/6) There are 2 ingots in the 2nd large dumpster to the left.

itm_02000f39.summary: Marie is the daughter of Ishmael Ashur and Sandra Kundanika, living in Haven in 2277.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: Less than a year old, Marie was born with a natural resistance to radiation and troglodyte degeneration contagion, and because of this unique gift, she has been studied by her parents to find a cure to help with the constant radiation in the Pitt. Teddy bears are her favorite toy.

sections.title: Interactions with the player character
sections.text:
Quests:
• Free Labor: Control over Marie is the central objective for both sides of the conflict. Steal the baby away from her parents or leave the people of the Pitt to suffer in slavery.

itm_0200b74b.summary: Scoped .44 Magnum is a weapon in The Pitt (Damage 35, uses .44 Magnum Round, value 300 caps). Linked to quests: Into The Pitt.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The scoped.44 Magnum is a very high-powered pistol. It has a very long effective range, which is further extended by the scope but also has a low rate of fire for a double-action revolver. There is no recoil when looking through the scope and firing.

Durability:
A fully-repaired Magnum can fire approximately 229 rounds, or 39 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Blackhawk - While it is much stronger than the regular.44, it is also the fastest to degrade of the unique versions.
• Callahan's Magnum FO3BS - Named after famous gunfighter and security guard Harold Callahan, Callahan's Magnum is the more effective version of Blackhawk, dealing more damage with slightly more wear and tear on the gun.
• Paulson's revolver FO3MZ - Drawn by space cowboy Paulson in the hostile confines of Mothership Zeta, it fires a slew of pellets instead of a single bullet. It is also unique for not having a scope, while other variants of.44 Magnum revolvers do.
• Wernher's scoped.44 Magnum FO3TP - An unobtainable version of the scoped.44 Magnum carried by Wernher. It has significantly higher health but is otherwise identical to the standard variant.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• In the truck to the left of the tent where you find the 5th Keller family transcript.
• Inside Vance's office wall safe during the Blood Ties quest. Must be stolen.
• On one of the skeletal remains in the Marigold station, along with a box of.44 Magnum cartridges.
• On a table a few feet away from the very hard locked door in the broken bow portion of Rivet City, near Horace Pinkerton's lab.
• Inside Reilly's Rangers headquarters.
• Mister Crowley of Underworld, Eulogy Jones of Paradise Falls, Willy Wilson of Andale, Billy Creel in Megaton, and Crow, the traveling merchant, all wield this gun.
• In a sunken boat near the Jefferson Memorial.
• Under a flight of stairs in the Hubris Comics printing room.
• Near a rotting brahmin corpse in the Shalebridge Hill ant tunnels.

itm_0200b66c.summary: Man Opener is a weapon in The Pitt (Damage 35, value 200 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The Man Opener ignores normal Damage Resistance, making it useful against armored enemies.

Durability:
Man Opener can successfully strike about 457 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Steel saw - a weaker version of the auto-axe that can be found on certain slaves.
• The Mauler - the strongest variant of the auto-axe.
• Auto axe - a modified and stronger version of the steel saw made out of old car parts.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The weapon is found on a bed in the back of the supply plant in The Pitt steelyard close to a single steel ingot. Enter the plant, then go east through the hallway. Turn north and continue until you reach two exits. Take the left, continue through the passage, climb the stairs and eventually exit into a large room. There's a bed on the left as you enter. The Man Opener is on the bed.

itm_0200b514.summary: The Mauler is a weapon in The Pitt (Damage 45, value 200 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: Everett says that this is one of his favorite weapons, and that he used it to chop up ghouls and trogs from the Pitt to Monroeville.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
It is a unique auto axe that deals much more damage than the original. It has a larger damage/hit and damage/second ratio compared to the standard auto axe (45 compared to 35) and uses less AP (50 compared to 65).

Durability:
The Mauler can successfully strike about 356 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Steel saw - a weaker version of the auto-axe that can be found on certain slaves.
• Auto axe - a modified and stronger version of the steel saw made out of old car parts.
• Man Opener - a unique variant of the auto axe that ignores armor.

itm_0200b513.summary: Metal Blaster is a weapon in The Pitt (Damage 55, uses Microfusion Cell, value 1000 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The Metal Blaster fires nine separate beams per microfusion cell expended, with the damage being split evenly between the nine beams. Outside of V.A.T.S., each beam can cause a separate Critical Hit, doing 27 damage for each beam striking the target. A sneak attack critical with the Better Criticals perk has the potential to inflict 839 damage if all beams connect with a target. Even outside of sneak attack criticals, a critical hit-optimized player character can, on average, deal almost three times the displayed damage every time the weapon is fired. The spread of the beams increases when used in V.A.T.S., however, and may strike wide of a selected target. It is also impossible for more than one beam to critically hit in V.A.T.S, drastically reducing its potential damage. It can be repaired with standard laser rifles.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Laser rifle - the standard variant found throughout the Capital Wasteland.
• Wazer Wifle - a unique variant with higher damage and durability as well as a larger magazine.
• FO3BS Tri-beam laser rifle - a variant that fires three high-powered beams per shot, similar to the Metal Blaster, though it does require three microfusion cells every time the trigger is pulled.

• A "demo" version of the laser rifle is included in Fallout 3, presumably left from the game's E3 demo. It does one point less damage per shot and less than half the critical damage than the standard variant, but has a much higher critical chance percentage. It is not used anywhere in the game and is only accessible through the use of console commands.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text: The weapon is located in the Steelyard where it can be given as a reward from Everett by finding a total of 50 steel ingots during Mill Worker.

itm_0200b512.summary: The Perforator is a unique weapon in the Fallout 3 add-on The Pitt. As of 2277, it belongs to Everett who considers it the best weapon he's ever owned.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The Perforator is a unique Infiltrator. It has the same appearance as the standard Infiltrator. It does more damage per shot, has a higher DPS, critical chance and critical damage, but a higher AP cost and significantly less durability. The biggest differences are the reduced rate of fire; the Perforator fires 2 shots for every 3 shots that the Infiltrator can fire and the reduced spread (which makes the rifle functionally more accurate over a longer distance). This gun is equipped with a suppressor making it silent.

Although the Perforator is a unique Infiltrator, it cannot be repaired with Infiltrators, but can be repaired with assault rifles. Because it has an attack rate of 6 per second, it fires two shots in V.A.T.S.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Assault rifle - The common variant in Fallout 3.
• Infiltrator FO3TP - A scoped, silenced and stockless version of the R-91 assault rifle, it functions similarly to the silenced 10mm pistol in that, while not as loud, it deals less damage than its roaring cousin.
• Sim version FO3OA - A sim-only version of the weapon which differs only in health (essentially non-degrading). It features a cleaner, less-battered texture with fresh wooden and darker metal areas than its wasteland counterpart.

• Wanda - A unique R-91 assault rifle that was cut from the final game.
• Alloy steel assault rifle FO3OA- A variant named "alloy steel assault rifle" can be found in the data files for Operation: Anchorage. It uses the Anchorage-specific texture for the weapon, but aside from name and appearance is identical to the standard R-91 assault rifle.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text: • Everett will give the Lone Wanderer the Perforator once they have turned over 90 steel ingots.

itm_0200b4b3.summary: Steel Knuckles is a weapon in The Pitt (Damage 9, value 20 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The steel knuckles do slightly more damage per hit than the brass or spiked variants, but they really shine when used in V.A.T.S. The steel knuckles use only 14 AP per swing, giving it one of the lowest weapon AP costs in the game.

Durability:
The steel knuckles can successfully strike about 1111 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Brass knuckles - the common variant found through the Capital Wasteland.
• Spiked knuckles - a variant that deals higher damage.
• Plunkett's Valid Points - a unique weapon found on Junders Plunkett at the Arlington House.
• Love Tap - a cut variant only obtainable via console commands.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The steel knuckles can only be obtained by turning in a total 30 steel ingots to Everett during the Mill Worker quest.

itm_0200a7cb.summary: Wild Bill's Sidearm is a weapon in The Pitt (Damage 10, uses .32 Caliber Round, value 250 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
Wild Bill's Sidearm is more durable than the standard.32 pistol and it fires very fast outside of V.A.T.S., about as fast as one can tap the fire button. Its damage per shot and critical damage are also much higher than those of the standard.32 pistol.

Durability:
Wild Bill's Sidearm can fire a total of about 833 rounds, the equivalent of 167 reloads, from full condition before breaking, roughly 56 more rounds than the regular.32 pistol.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
•.32 pistol - The standard variant.

itm_020032e1.summary: Auto Axe is a weapon in The Pitt (Damage 35, value 200 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: In helping Wernher and Midea prepare for the slave rebellion in 2277 against Ashur and his raiders controlling the Pitt, Marco has spent a long time developing a modification to the pre-War steel saw used by the slaves, dubbing it the "Auto Axe" and making it from industrial materials and scrap metal derived from the wrecks of cars littering the bridge into the city.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
A melee weapon consisting of a modified steel saw upgraded with car engine parts, with the original tool strongly resembling a concrete saw or industrial grinder. The original blade seems to have been modified or replaced with a blade of a different kind, one with four roughly circular holes at the edges which creates four individual blades resembling axe blades.

The auto axe inflicts large amounts of damage with its sharp rotating blades and functions like the Ripper. It can also be repaired using Rippers, including the unique Ripper, Jack. Damage done by this weapon can be increased with the Auto Axpert perk.

Durability:
The auto axe can successfully strike about 457 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Steel saw - a weaker, but more durable version of the auto axe that can be found on certain slaves.
• Man Opener - a unique variant of the auto axe that ignores armor, including power armor.
• The Mauler - a unique variant that is less durable but deals higher base damage than the standard variant.

itm_02009f4c.summary: Note from Wild Bill is a note / holotape in The Pitt (value 0 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.
itm_02009f4c.text: I'm not going to make it, Milly...I'm sorry. I knew everyone thought I could do it, but they don't know what's out here. It's not just Trogs...but others. The Wildmen. Kind of funny considering my nickname 'Wild Bill' back at the mill. Finding the ingots wasn't the hard part...they're everywhere. The problem was trying to make my way back to the mill. My trusty sidearm came in handy more than once, but I soon found myself in more trouble than I could handle. The gunfire alerted the Wildmen and I assume it's only a matter of time before they find me. I'm sorry for letting everyone down at the mill. Let everyone know I tried my hardest....Bye.

sections.title: Location

itm_020080a6.summary: Cure Research is a note / holotape in The Pitt (value 0 caps). Available across The Pitt locations and merchants.
itm_020080a6.text:
Cure Development Progress
Research by Dr. Sandra Kundanika

Observational tests on isolated samples suggest the subject has a natural adaptive immunity to the so called "Trog mutation". Furthermore, it appears that this immunity carries on to other forms of radiation-induced diseases - from radiation sickness to larger mutations such as the all-too-common development of a sixth toe.

Attempts to isolate these effects have been slow going, due in part to the delicate nature of testing. Prospects exist for duplication, but the unique and delicate nature of the subject requires utmost care in testing.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: It can be obtained from Sandra Kundanika or a terminal in her room in Haven.

itm_02007356.summary: Ammo Mill Instructions is a note / holotape in The Pitt (value 0 caps). Linked to quests: Free Labor.
itm_02007356.text:
The Steel Mill's ammo press is key to the military might of The Pitt, as it allows the user to repurpose simple ammunition to more convenient calibers. All soldiers, traders, and raiders in The Pitt are expected to be familiar with its use. Found in the Steel Mill, the ammo press overlooks the hole. Load unused ammunition types and raw material into the Materials Bin, and activate the nearby Ammo Press terminal. Select the new ammunition type, press it, and collect your new ammunition from the Materials Bin.

5mm
5.56mm
10mm
.32 Caliber
.308 Caliber
.44 magnum
Shotgun shells
Raw Material Types:
Any of the above ammunition
Scrap metal

Scientist outfits are pieces of clothing. They provide a bonus of +5 to Science.

itm_030088b5.summary: Composite recon armor and composite recon helmet are cut content pieces of armor in Fallout 3.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The armor is identical to recon armor in terms of stats and looks except for increased durability (item health of 600 compared to 400 for the standard armor). The helmet is a recon armor helmet with increased durability (item health of 70 compared to 40 for the standard helmet) and an additional bonus of +1 to Perception.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: Composite recon armor and composite recon helmet can be found in the game files of Fallout 3 but are not used anywhere in the game. They can only be obtained by using console commands. The add-on Broken Steel adds another identical version of the helmet to the game, which is worn by the armory master on the mobile base crawler.

itm_03006530.summary: Deathclaw Control Scrambler is a misc / quest item in Broken Steel (value 0 caps). Linked to quests: Shock Value.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: A prototype device made by Scribe Vallincourt, the deathclaw control scrambler is a modified standard transmitter that can override the Enclave's deathclaw control signal. The device is constantly broadcasting its override signal, meaning that the device passively takes control of the deathclaw without any action taken by the carrier. Vallincourt provides the device to the player for testing during Shock Value to assist them in entering Old Olney.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: Obtained from Scribe Vallincourt during Shock Value.

sections.title: Related quest
sections.text: • Shock Value: The scrambler automatically turns any Enclave-controlled deathclaw friendly as long as the Lone Wanderer is within range of the transmitters of the domestication units. When the Lone Wanderer is going out of range, the device will first start to beep periodically and finally, the deathclaw will die.

itm_03005687.summary: Tesla Coil is a misc / quest item in Broken Steel (value 0 caps). Linked to quests: Shock Value.

sections.title: Background
sections.text:
Before the Great War, a power plant owned by PPE was constructed in the vicinity of Old Olney, and the staff there conducted research and development on a Tesla coil. The plant was located near the S. Wilson office building and a children's hospital; when the bombs fell, these structures sank underground and formed a connected passageway to the power plant.

Around two weeks after the Enclave's defeat at the Jefferson Memorial and the reactivation of Project Purity by Lyons' Brotherhood of Steel in 2277, the Brotherhood dispatched the Lone Wanderer to investigate the Olney Powerworks facility and salvage the Tesla coil for use as a defensive measure at the Citadel. Parts of it were also later incorporated into a new model of Tesla cannon that was supplied to the Lone Wanderer ahead of the Battle of Adams Air Force Base.

sections.title: Location
sections.text:
The Tesla coil can be found in Olney Powerworks, inside the central reactor. It is protected by an electrical field which can be turned off by the three surrounding switches. Alternatively, there is a room next to the coil with a remote access terminal inside requiring Science 75 to hack. That terminal releases a failsafe that turns off the electrical field.

Taking the Tesla coil before turning off the electrical field will cause the player character to lose a significant amount of Health.

itm_0300b806.summary: Callahan's Magnum is a weapon in Broken Steel (Damage 65, uses .44 Magnum Round, value 750 caps). Available across Broken Steel locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
Callahan's Magnum is a unique scoped.44 Magnum previously used by Pentagon military policeman Harold Callahan. It's the most powerful Small Guns handgun in the game used by the player character.

Durability:
Callahan's Magnum can fire a total of about 205 rounds, the equivalent of 35 reloads, from full condition before breaking, roughly 23 rounds fewer than the normal scoped.44.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Scoped.44 Magnum - The standard variant.
• Blackhawk - While it's much stronger than the regular.44, it is also the weakest of the unique versions. However, it is the best version in the original game with no add-ons.
• FO3MZ Paulson's revolver - Drawn by space cowboy Paulson in the hostile confines of Mothership Zeta, it lacks the scope and fires a slew of pellets instead of a single bullet.
• FO3TP Wernher's scoped.44 Magnum - An unobtainable version of the scoped.44 Magnum carried by Wernher. It has significantly higher health but is otherwise identical to the standard variant.

sections.title: Location
sections.text:
It can be found in a hard safe within the ruins of the Citadel if one chooses to destroy it while on-board the Enclave mobile base crawler during the quest Who Dares Wins. Enter the door at the bottom of the crater, head up the stairs, and enter the cubicle against the far wall. The safe requires a Lockpick skill of 75, alternatively one can hack a terminal with a Science skill of 75.

This weapon is unobtainable if one does not choose to destroy the Citadel unless console commands are used.

itm_030091b3.summary: Slo-Burn Flamer is a weapon in Broken Steel (Damage 18, uses Flamer Fuel, value 500 caps). Available across Broken Steel locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
This weapon consumes an incredible amount of ammunition, as a single slight burst consumes 3 flamer fuel instaneously. It has no 'warm up time', and the residual flame does 8 damage per second for 5 seconds.

Durability:
The slo-burn flamer can shoot a total of about 185 units of flamer fuel, the equivalent of 4 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Flamer - Standard flamer.
• Burnmaster - Found in the Franklin Metro utility.
• Rapid-torch flamer FO3BS - Located in the Adams storage facility.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The slo-burn flamer can be found on the upper level of the southeast portion of the launch platform base inside the Enclave mobile platform during the Who Dares Wins quest. It is on a platform with deathclaws that are in stasis fields. It is in 100% condition when found.

itm_030091b1.summary: The rapid-torch flamer is a unique weapon added in the Fallout 3 add-on Broken Steel.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The rapid-torch flamer's stats are almost identical to the stats of a regular flamer. The only difference from the normal flamer is the attack animation. The difference in animation does have actual in-game impact, although minor. With the rapid-torch flamer, it's enough to quickly tap with mouse or trigger to fire the flamer, expending 1 point of ammunition in the process.

With the regular flamer, there is a slight delay before the gas gets ignited which then propels fire, so in order to just expend 1 point of ammunition one needs to hold fire button a little bit (but not too long to avoid expending two ammunition points). Therefore, with the rapid-torch, one can conserve ammunition a bit better than with a regular flamer.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Flamer - Standard flamer.
• Burnmaster - found in the Franklin Metro utility.
• Slo-burn flamer FO3BS - found on the upper level of the southeast portion of the Launch Platform Base inside the Enclave mobile platform.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The rapid-torch flamer is located in the Adams storage facility, slightly south of where the mobile base crawler was located. It will be on a counter along with several missiles, two mini nukes, a bottle of Nuka-Cola Quantum and other odds and ends.

itm_03008895.summary: The precision Gatling laser is a unique Gatling laser, added to Fallout 3 with the add-on Broken Steel.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
Despite its name, the precision Gatling laser is not more accurate than the standard Gatling laser or Vengeance, having the same spread and fire rate. The main advantage of the precision Gatling laser is its high critical chance multiplier. Its effectiveness is dependent on the player character's base critical chance and whether the Better Criticals perk is chosen. It is also repairable with regular Gatling lasers.

With a value of 3000 caps, it is the most valuable weapon in the game.

Durability:
Just like the standard Gatling laser, the precision Gatling laser can successfully fire about 3125 beams, the equivalent of 13 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Gatling laser - the standard variant found in the Capital Wasteland.
• Vengeance - a more powerful Gatling laser, with slightly less durability.

sections.title: Location
sections.text:
This Gatling laser is only found on the armory master during Who Dares Wins, the final quest in Broken Steel's main plot line, where one must assault the Enclave-controlled Adams Air Force Base.

Upon getting into the mobile platform, search for the armory (not the one on the level the Lone Wanderer first enters), there are two entrances: One leads through the mainframe and the other through the main deck where the deathclaws are confined.

Near the entrance from the main deck, one will see an Enclave soldier, the armory master, wearing Tesla armor and a unique recon helmet called the composite recon helmet. He will be carrying the precision Gatling laser.

itm_03006725.summary: Tesla Cannon is a weapon in Broken Steel (Damage 40, uses Electron Charge Pack, value 1800 caps). Available across Broken Steel locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The Tesla cannon is a shoulder-mounted energy weapon that fires powerful blasts of electricity, powered by electron charge packs. It can be fired only once before reloading.

The questline of Broken Steel includes having to find a Tesla coil for this weapon in order to help the Brotherhood of Steel build it.

Durability:
The Tesla cannon can fire a total of about 563 shots from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
There are a total of thirteen standard Tesla cannons, but only a maximum of eleven can be obtained in one play-through.
• The first Tesla cannon can be acquired upon the Lone Wanderer's initial arrival at Adams Air Force Base. There will be a resupply crate directly to the player character's left near the wall upon exiting the Presidential metro.
• Once one leaves Adams Air Force Base, if they did not blow up the Citadel and return there, two Tesla cannons can be found in the Citadel laboratory after finishing the quest Who Dares Wins, on a table in front of Liberty Prime's docking bay.
• If one blew up the Citadel, they can find two Tesla cannons in the Citadel armory. If one did not blow up the Citadel they can pick the lock to get into the armory but there are no Tesla cannons there.

sections.title: Related quests
sections.text:
• Shock Value
• Who Dares Wins - Given during quest.

itm_03001084.summary: The heavy incinerator is a weapon which is added to Fallout 3 with the Broken Steel add-on.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The heavy incinerator is essentially a napalm launcher; it lobs flammable fuel with a splash damage possibility at the target in an arc. These 'projectiles' cause splash damage, and will most often set the enemy on fire, unless a large 'miss' variance is registered. The heavy incinerator can be fired at extremely long distances with relatively good accuracy; it can even be effectively fired across the Potomac River to hit enemies on the other side.

Just having the heavy incinerator equipped is enough to ignite gas leaks because of the pilot light on the front of the weapon, like some other fire-based weapons in the game.

Durability:
The heavy incinerator can successfully shoot about 222 times, the equivalent of 10 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• It is equipped by Enclave Hellfire troopers.
• Carried by Lag-Bolt in La Maison Beauregard during the unmarked quest The Sorrowful Suitor.
• In the mobile base crawler's launch platform base's armory.

itm_03004c7a.summary: Holy water is a consumable item. It is produced by Mother Curie III by irradiating Aqua Pura.

sections.title: Background
sections.text:
Holy water is Aqua Pura unknowingly stolen from Megaton by the Church of the Apostles of the Eternal Light (an offshoot of the Church of the Children of Atom) to which a large amount of "Atom's Light" (radiation) has been added in order to spread "the Glow of Atom's Light" to the "unenlightened."

While the Church of the Children of Atom wish for Division (getting their atoms split), the Apostles of the Eternal Light wish to feel Atom's Glow (become irradiated). They believe that becoming a ghoul is humanity's next step towards perfection, and so "bless" Aqua Pura to help people achieve this holy state.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• After Rosa gives holy water to Micky, it can either be pickpocketed from him or taken from his inventory after his scripted death.
• Rosa also carries a bottle of holy water, which can be pickpocketed.
• When approaching Brother Gerard for the first time, he will give the player a bottle. He has two to four more bottles in his inventory, which can be pickpocketed.
• An infinite number can be obtained from Brother Gerard by using an exploit. Drop all holy water and speak to him again, and he will hand over another bottle (this stops working after the first time the player drinks any, because that triggers the next step in Gerard's conversation script).

itm_0300bd82.summary: Dunbar's Note is a note / holotape in Broken Steel (value 0 caps). Available across Broken Steel locations and merchants.
itm_0300bd82.text:
If you're reading this, it's because you might be able to help.

We're thinking about branching out. Underworld was a good start, but we've found an even safer place for us to set up a new place to call home.

Old Olney.

No one ever goes there. No one would ever think to look for us there. There's tons of space under the town. So we're looking for a few strong backs to help knock down some walls, clear some space underground, and help get things up and running.

-S

sections.title: Location
sections.text: It can be found on the ghoul Dunbar in Old Olney underground and is written by Sanders.

itm_0300b957.summary: Sorry, My Darling is a note / holotape in Broken Steel (value 0 caps). Available across Broken Steel locations and merchants.
itm_0300b957.text: If someone finds this... please get this to my lover at the La Maison Beauregard Hotel in East Georgetown... he'll want to hear what I have to say. My darling... they've found me. I... I tried to get away... tried to get away so we could be together once again... I know you risked your life to get it to me.... combing the ruins, avoiding the Super Mutants... all for me. It seems I shall never lay my eyes upon your gift... you... you'll have to keep it and remember me every time you see it. I'm so sorry my darling... so... so... sorry I've let you down. So many have died for this thing... so many hearts have been broken. Please remember, I'll always love you... you will be with me forever in my spirit... I... I...l-love... you...

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The disk is found in the Presidential metro. Before boarding the train to the Adams Air Force Base, go up the opposite staircase toward The Capitol Building and you will find it next to a skeleton on a bench. It will start the unmarked quest The Sorrowful Suitor for receiving the all-nighter nightwear.

itm_030081e3.summary: Flamer fuel stash holotape is a holotape found at Adams Air Force Base in the Fallout 3 add-on Broken Steel.
itm_030081e3.text:
Little Sister,

I've stashed away a considerable amount of fuel behind the small building west of the Air Traffic Control Tower as you requested. The container's tucked away under some barrels and tires. And no, I couldn't safely confiscate an incinerator for you, that's your job. I took too big a risk hiding that fuel for you in the first place. If you do come across an incinerator, please be careful. Anyway, they're shipping me out to some relay station far west of here in the Wasteland. I'm afraid I won't be seeing you for a while.

Take care and good luck in all your endeavors.

Your Big Brother.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: It is in possession of a female Enclave scientist, located in the southeast research hangar of the base. This can be easily missed, as when the Lone Wanderer presses on to the Mobile Base Crawler, the constant spawning of corpses from the battlefield will result in the scientist disappearing.

itm_03006718.summary: Talon Company merc log #1 is a holotape added with the Fallout 3 add-on Broken Steel.
itm_03006718.text: It's been confirmed. The Purifier has been activated. We've been ordered to fortify our position and wait for orders. With a lull in the fighting, we set up and fortified our position outside the Capitol Building near Seward Square. Things have been relatively quiet around here lately, but that'll all change when word spreads of the purifier. Anyone and everyone will do what they can to get their hands on some of that water. For life or profit, it makes no difference. Same old killing, just a different ingredient.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: Found outside the Capitol Building, in Seward Square at a Talon Company camp.

itm_03006717.summary: Wastelander Holotape #1 is a note / holotape in Broken Steel (value 0 caps). Available across Broken Steel locations and merchants.
itm_03006717.text: We've been in this position for a couple of days now. No sign of the caravans. This is bullshit! I want some god damn water! I'm gonna kill Jed for putting us girls through this shit. Why get close to the caravan when we could just blow 'em away from the distance? He says we need the ammunition and can't afford to lose anybody. "Just use your good looks or something", he says. What an ass.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The wastelander holotape #1 is an audio log of a female wastelander describing how she and her companions were ordered by Jed to use their charm to lure a water caravan into an ambush. There are two pieces of sexy sleepwear and a leather armor on the ground next to the holotape and party hat on the table. Outside the corner ruins, are three female wastelanders. Killing them results in no loss of karma.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: South of Arefu, between VAPL-58 power station and Kaelyn's Bed & Breakfast, under a rocky cliff, where the skeleton of Patrick who committed suicide is located. (See Patrick's farewell)

itm_030064ff.text:
Good people of Megaton, your salvation is at hand!

We are the Apostles of Eternal Light. To heal this wounded city, we are willing to provide any and all supplicants with cleansing holy water.

Come to our monastery in Springvale, and Brother Gerard will minister to your every need.

We will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the Water of Light.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:

itm_04003fa3.summary: Yeast is a miscellaneous item in the Fallout 3 add-on Point Lookout and Fallout: New Vegas.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: Yeast is a fungal micro-organism used in the baking of bread and distilling of alcohol. When yeast ferments, it produces carbon dioxide gas and alcohols, making it a staple in the production of the two.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
Yeast:
Yeast, in both games, is used in producing moonshine. In Point Lookout, it's commonplace to find it in houses, storefronts and on swampfolk. It's much more difficult to find in the Mojave.

itm_04002f46.summary: The Krivbeknih is a misc / quest item in Point Lookout (value 15 caps). Linked to quests: The Dark Heart of Blackhall.

sections.title: Background
sections.text:
Widely purported to possess a dark power, Obadiah Blackhall attests that the Krivbeknih was once owned by his ancestor, Constance Blackhall, and rightfully belongs to his family. It is known that Constance was an unnaturally long-lived woman who led the swampfolk in rituals using the Krivbeknih, both before and after the Great War. She was the sister of Richard Dunwich, and an occult figure in her own right. According to local legend, the book was stolen from her, which led to her losing her influence over the swampfolk, and she died before she could recover it.

At some point during or after the 2250s, a man claimed to be a "Ranger" brought the Krivbeknih back from an expedition, believing it to be valuable.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The Krivbeknih is a large brown book concerning the dark arts, with a bloody gash across the front of it. The Christian Marcella wants the book destroyed, but the occultist Obadiah Blackhall demands the book be returned to him, as it once belonged to his family. When the Lone Wanderer takes the Krivbeknih from the ritual site, objects on the table behind it will begin to shake and fall over.

When pressed against the Dunwich Obelisk, the book bursts into flames, as do any ghouls present in the ritual chamber. The destruction of the Krivbeknih yields a major positive Karma bonus of +500.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The Krivbeknih is found in the deepest level of the ritual site, in a bowl full of blood on a stone altar.

itm_0401098a.summary: Ritual Knife is a weapon in Point Lookout (Damage 6, value 20 caps). Available across Point Lookout locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The ritual knife is used by the swampfolk in rituals. It can be repaired with knives as well as the slasher knife and Ant's Sting. This weapon has a high rate of attack and the second-lowest AP cost in the game.

Durability:
The ritual knife can successfully strike about 1333 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Knife - The common variant found throughout the Capital Wasteland.
• Ant's Sting - Obtained by siding with the AntAgonizer in The Superhuman Gambit, Ant's Sting is slightly stronger than the regular knife, and deals poison damage over time.
• Slasher knife - Appears in Tranquility Lane and can only be obtained outside of the simulation through console commands.
• FO3PL Toy knife - Using even less AP than the ritual knife (10 instead of 12) the toy knife uses the lowest amount of AP for any weapon in Fallout 3. However, it does very little damage, much less than the regular knife.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The ritual knife is found in the caves beneath the ritual site, stuck in a skull on the sacrificing table near The Krivbeknih, after beginning the quest The Dark Heart of Blackhall.

itm_0400ed14.summary: The Backwater rifle is a unique lever-action rifle in the Fallout 3 add-on Point Lookout.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: The Backwater rifle boasts the highest damage-per-shot of all 10mm weapons in Fallout 3, while also possessing the second-highest damage-per-shot of all rifle-type weapons. However, despite this weapon's attacks and critical bonuses each being 5 damage lower than those of Lincoln's repeater (resulting in 10 less damage total on a critical hit), the backwater rifle's 5x critical chance multiplier is capable of offering up to a 90% chance to critical for a character with a maxed-out base critical chance (10 Luck, the Finesse perk and the critical chance version of Survival Expert), where Lincoln's repeater, with its lower 2x multiplier would only offer a 36% chance to critical with the same stats.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• FO3PL Lever-action rifle - The standard variant of this weapon.
• Lincoln's repeater - While strictly a lever-action rifle that uses.44 Magnum rounds, Lincoln's repeater is only repairable with hunting rifles. It is a very powerful and accurate firearm. Appearance-wise, it looks identical to the lever-action rifle apart from its textures.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: • On a shelf next to the door in the room downstairs in the Chinese intelligence bunker. It can be considered a reward for the quest The Velvet Curtain.

itm_0400ed0f.summary: The Dismemberer is a unique axe which is added to Fallout 3 with the Point Lookout add-on.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
It looks identical to the regular axe, albeit more powerful, and has the ability to gib enemies without the Bloody Mess perk.

Durability:
The Dismemberer can successfully strike about 480 times from full condition before breaking, roughly 20 hits less than the standard axe.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text: • Axe - The common variant found in Point Lookout.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: This axe is given as a reward by Plik after completing Plik's Safari.

itm_0400d5b3.summary: Pa's Fishing Aid is a weapon in Point Lookout (Damage 80, uses 12-Gauge Shotgun Shell, value 350 caps). Available across Point Lookout locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
It looks identical to its regular version, the double-barrel shotgun, but differs in damage, value, and other characteristics. It can only be repaired with combat shotguns.

Durability:
Pa's Fishing Aid can fire a total of about 125 shots from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The weapon is cut from the game and can only be acquired through the use of the console, or by transporting to the test cell location DLC04testPhil and picking it up from the table.

itm_0400d5a8.summary: Fertilizer Shovel is a weapon in Point Lookout (Damage 15, value 55 caps). Available across Point Lookout locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
A plain-looking, long-handled shovel with a worn blade caked in "dirt," the fertilizer shovel has one of the longest reaches of any melee weapon in the game, making it effective for fending off large groups of enemies. In addition, each hit inflicts 4 poison damage for 10 seconds, that stacks with each hit (due to the fertilizer smeared on the blade), so large amounts of damage can be applied quickly.

It can be repaired with other Shovels.

Durability:
The fertilizer shovel can successfully strike about 533 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The fertilizer shovel can be obtained from the tribal, Croatoa (keeper of the punga fruits at Ark & Dove Cathedral), with the Child at Heart perk, or by passing a Speech check after asking about his 'secrets.' One may also kill him and retrieve it from his body, but this method is not recommended, unless both the quests, Walking with Spirits and Hearing Voices have already been completed.

itm_0400d1e4.summary: Bio-Gas Canister is a weapon in Point Lookout (Damage 1, value 50 caps). Available across Point Lookout locations and merchants.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: Not intended as weapons, these are the result of a Bysshe Company research team sent to Point Lookout to survey its rich natural gas deposits. The story goes that these deposits accumulated from the mass graves of thousands of Confederate prisoners who died near Point Lookout in the later years of the American Civil War, although the amount of natural gas that would provide would actually be negligible.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: It deploys a cloud of natural gas on the target. As with all gas leaks, it will ignite from explosives, energy weapons and conventional fire while inside the cloud. This results in a fireball on the target.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text: 17 bio-gas canisters in total can be found in the course of the quest An Antique Land in the excavated muck holes. 7 are located in the muck holes themselves, and 10 are rewarded upon completion of the questline. They cannot be found anywhere else.

itm_0400c1c3.summary: The microwave emitter is a unique energy weapon added to Fallout 3 in the Point Lookout add-on as the final reward of the add-on's main questline.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The microwave emitter uses the same in-game model as the Mesmetron. However, unlike the relatively rare mesmetron power cells made by Implied Hypnotics which are intended as non-lethal and to merely daze and confuse a target, the microwave emitter is modified to use the much more common military microfusion cells which are used by standard, lethal-force energy weapons.

Therefore, the emitter is intended as a lethal version of the Mesmetron which burns, sets on fire, explodes, or disintegrates a target with blasts of intense and concentrated microwave radiation. Limb shots may cause gibbing even without the Bloody Mess perk, and headshots will cause heads to explode. Fatal critical hits will not turn enemies into piles of goo as with plasma weapons but will turn enemies into piles of ash, like with laser weapons.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text: • Mesmetron - An experimental weapon that can be given to the player character by Grouse, the Mesmetron will confuse and daze an enemy instead of disintegrating them but is visually identical to the microwave emitter.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The microwave emitter is found at the end of the quest A Meeting of the Minds, in the reward vault behind Professor Calvert's brain in his underground lab beneath the Point Lookout Lighthouse. This is the final reward in the Point Lookout main questline.

itm_040088de.summary: Lever-Action Rifle is a weapon in Point Lookout (Damage 40, uses 10mm Round, value 200 caps). Available across Point Lookout locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The lever-action rifle is a high-powered rifle using the common 10mm round. It has a rather low rate of fire, as the action needs to be cycled after every shot, but makes up for it by being highly accurate, and having a large ammunition capacity. However, it will break easily.

The lever-action rifle has an object effect which inflicts an extra 35 damage per hit when used by non-player characters against the Lone Wanderer. This damage ignores Damage Resistance, and is independent of the condition of the weapon.

Durability:
The lever-action rifle can fire a total of about 250 rounds, the equivalent of 25 reloads, from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• FO3PL Backwater rifle - An all-around better lever-action rifle. It does more damage, is more durable, and is slightly lighter.
• Lincoln's repeater - While strictly a lever-action rifle that uses.44 Magnum rounds, Lincoln's repeater is only repairable with hunting rifles. It is a very powerful and accurate firearm. Appearance wise, it looks identical to the lever-action rifle apart from its textures.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Haley and Madame Panada will both sell lever-action rifles.
• Scrappers, creepers, and brawlers will occasionally carry these.
• Point Lookout tribals can sometimes carry them.
• A single rifle can be found in an alcove on the right side of the bumper car pen, when looking at the bumper cars from the House of Wares. A dead smuggler can also be found in the alcove.
• During the quest Hearing Voices, several rifles can be found in the sea cave on the floor in the room where one encounters Jackson.
• One can be found on the workbench in the basement of the Trapper's shack.
• One can be found on the seabed near the dinosaur remains, under the buoy directly south of the Coastal grotto.

itm_0400838f.summary: Axe is a weapon in Point Lookout (Damage 20, value 60 caps). Available across Point Lookout locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
An old woodcutter's axe, its blade is visible stained with rust and blood. It is used by the swampfolk and tribals and can only be repaired with other axes.

Similar to the tri-beam laser rifle in Broken Steel, the axe has an object effect which inflicts an extra 35 damage per hit when used by non-player characters against the player. This damage ignores Damage Resistance and is independent of the condition of the weapon.

Durability:
The axe can successfully strike about 500 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text: • The Dismemberer - Obtained from Plik after completing Plik's Safari. It is slightly stronger, and has a very high chance to turn enemies into paste and giblets, which also restores 5 AP.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
Axes can be found on all swampfolk, but especially trackers and bruisers. The Point Lookout tribals will also carry them. Many of the buildings in Point Lookout may also have axes in them.
• Two at the jet crash site, near the plane.

itm_04007473.summary: Double-Barrel Shotgun is a weapon in Point Lookout (Damage 85, uses 12-Gauge Shotgun Shell, value 175 caps). Available across Point Lookout locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
Unlike the similar sawed-off shotgun, this firearm has both its barrel and stock intact while being quite rusty and still requiring a metal strap to keep the forearm and barrels together. The gun fires both barrels at once, which forces one to reload immediately after each shot, though it has a short reload time of 0.8 seconds. The drawback to this is ammunition consumption, as again, each shot expends two shells.

This means that comparatively, while a weapon like a combat shotgun has only two chances to jam after a full spent magazine, the double-barrel shotgun has 57. The double-barrel shotgun has an object effect that inflicts an extra 35 damage per hit when used by non-player characters.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• FO3 Sawed-off shotgun - a variant found throughout the Capital Wasteland.
• FO3 The Kneecapper - a unique variant of the sawed-off shotgun, used by Ronald Laren in Girdershade.
• cut FO3PL Pa's Fishing Aid - a unique variant that was cut from the add-on.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Can be purchased from several merchants across Point Lookout.
• One may be found relatively early on, inside the naval recruiting center.
• One can also be found in the sea cave during Hearing Voices, in a surfaced wooden boat containing a skeleton, shotgun shells and pre-War money.
• One in the sea cave near the ladder to Point Lookout.
• One is also obtainable at the Homestead Motel, in the main lobby behind the counter and in room 1G.
• The tribals that invade Calvert Mansion during The Local Flavor also carry this weapon, as do various swampfolk around Point Lookout.
• Calvert Mansion, one in a corner of the dining room near a skeleton.
• One can be found on the porch of Marguerite's shack, on a small table.
• Carried by Jacob Humboldt and Richard Adlam.
• One near the large red ball at Ruzka's lair.

itm_04006ab7.summary: Toy Knife is a weapon in Point Lookout (Damage 1, value 20 caps). Available across Point Lookout locations and merchants.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
The toy knife is visually identical to the regular knife, but is only a toy version, possessing the lowest damage and durability of any weapon in the game. In addition, it cannot be used to repair other weapons or be repaired without the help of a merchant, making it impractical for anything other than serving as a collector's item.

Durability:
The toy knife can successfully strike 184 times from full condition before breaking.

sections.title: Variants
sections.text:
• Knife - the common variant found throughout the Capital Wasteland.
• Slasher knife - appears in Tranquility Lane and can only be obtained outside of the simulation through console commands.
• Ant's Sting - obtained by siding with the AntAgonizer in The Superhuman Gambit, Ant's Sting is slightly stronger than the regular knife, and deals poison damage over time.
• FO3PL Ritual knife - even more powerful than the Ant's Sting, the ritual knife only uses 12 AP for each V.A.T.S. attack.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The toy knife can be found directly south of Turtledove Detention Camp, close to a yellow sign that is near the road (which is visible on the world map). With ones back to the sign, turn until one sees a relatively long and impassible line made of bushes to the south / southwest. It is hidden behind it, sitting on a wooden crate with a hockey mask.

itm_0400422d.summary: Moonshine is a aid / chems & food in Point Lookout (value 50 caps). Linked to quests: A Spoonful of Whiskey.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
A potent potable that raises Charisma and Strength by 2 points each while reducing Intelligence by 2. In addition, it has a 10% chance to cause alcohol addiction.

As shown in the quest A Spoonful of Whiskey, moonshine is made from a potent mix of fission batteries, yeast, and wild or refined punga fruits. The Lone Wanderer can make six jugs of moonshine every 24 hours by taking the ingredients to Marguerite.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Moonshine is commonly found on enemies throughout Point Lookout, especially swampfolk.
• Two can be found in Marguerite's shack.
• Two can be found in Grower's shack.
• Two can be found in Blackhall Manor.
• One can be found next to a safe in second room of the Naval recruiting center.

itm_04003fe9.summary: Refined Punga Fruit is a aid / chems & food in Point Lookout (value 30 caps). Linked to quests: The Local Flavor, A Spoonful of Whiskey.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text: It is a variant of the wild punga fruit grown by Point Lookout's local tribals in the Ark & Dove Cathedral. Unique to punga fruit, it has the ability to scrub radiation from the body as well as heal at the same time. The perk Punga Power! (achieved from the Mother Punga) increases the radiation healing effects, but does not affect its HP healing. The refined punga fruit, as opposed to its wild cousin, is a smooth pale yellow-green fruit.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• 141 are found around the Ark & Dove Cathedral:
• One to the left of the initially barred entrance to the compound.
• 55 from plants outside the church.
• 83 from planters inside the church.
• Two on the desk in the back of the church.
• 10 are given to the player after completing the unmarked quest Tailing the Tomboy.
• Can be purchased from Tobar.
• Can be purchased from Capital Wasteland merchants after the Point Lookout add-on has been loaded.

itm_04003fc6.summary: Wild Punga Fruit is a aid / chems & food in Point Lookout (value 10 caps). Linked to quests: The Local Flavor, A Spoonful of Whiskey.

sections.title: Characteristics
sections.text:
It is a wild fruit that grows all over Point Lookout and has the unique function of scrubbing radiation from the system and healing at the same time. The perk Punga Power! increases the radiation healing effects, but does not affect its HP healing.

Unlike its refined cousin, the wild variety of punga fruit is more sickly looking, covered in a rough brown skin.

As discovered by Desmond Lockheart, punga emits electrical discharge similar to citrus fruits and even potatoes. His experiment may be observed in his lab in Calvert Mansion.

There is one gigantic wild punga seed known as the Mother Punga.

sections.title: Locations
sections.text:
• Wild punga fruit can be found across every stretch of Point Lookout, in the sacred bog, in the Ofie Clan Plot and near the many waterways that flow through Point Lookout.
• After downloading the add-on, traders across the Capital Wasteland will regularly stock these fruits, especially for those selling consumables.

itm_04010acc.summary: The holotape note is a holotape in the Fallout 3 add-on Point Lookout. It tells about a road accident, leading the Lone Wanderer to a lighthouse bulb at the truck wreckage.
itm_04010acc.text:
Blue -
Couldn't raise you on the phone this morning, so I'm having Jenny bring you this note. Your delivery for the store got turned around on those new roads and had an accident. He's run off the road by the Cathedral. They'll need some time to sort things out, but Pagano probably won't want to wait that long to replace the lighthouse's beacon bulbs. You might want to get over to the wreck yourself and hand-deliver the bulbs.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: The tape can be found at the top of the Point Lookout Lighthouse, near the broken rotating projector and at Haley's Hardware, next to the front door.

sections.title: Transcript
sections.text:

itm_04010a4d.summary: Box 1213 - Bern's voice is a holotape located in the grower's shack. It grants access to a safe deposit box in the People's Bank of Point Lookout.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: Upon entering the shack, turn left into the bedroom, the holotape will be on the bedside table. To access the safe deposit box, open the Pip-Boy, start playing the holodisk, and immediately exit the Pip-Boy 3000, before or after interacting with the voice-activated security system. The security system will report that access has been granted to the safe deposit box and it will open. The deposit box contains four stacks of pre-War money, and a sexy sleepwear.

sections.title: Transcript
sections.text: ...Don't tell Evelyn. The Password? "Buttercup", Why...

itm_0400b5e7.summary: Point Lookout is a note / holotape in Point Lookout (value 0 caps). Linked to quests: The Local Flavor.
itm_0400b5e7.text:
Greetings from Point Lookout!

Straight from the land of warm beaches and luscious wetlands comes the Duchess Gambit, the finest vessel on the east coast, piloted by Tobar the Ferryman.

And to the hungry masses of the Capital Wasteland, he brings the hearty punga fruit! A delicious and nutritious addition to your daily meal, its tangy taste is the most refreshing meal in the world.

Find the punga fruit at your local merchant now, or buy straight from the source at the Duchess Gambit, now docked south of the Citadel.

SPECIAL BONUS!
Hey, adventurers! Itching to find Point Lookout's treasures for yourself? Talk with Tobar to book passage back to this land of mystery!

itm_040072f8.summary: Note to Nadine is a note / holotape in Point Lookout (value 0 caps). Linked to quests: The Local Flavor.
itm_040072f8.text:
My darling little Nade,

I know life wasn't always the best at home, and we've had a few rough winters. I don't blame you for running off to find something better. At your age, you think you're wasting away at home while the world's just waiting for you to come get it.

When I was about your age, I ran off from my mom, too. And even though there were some terrible things along the way, it ended with me having you, so I can't complain. I just wish you could have seen your grandmother. I wish I had a chance to see her again, myself.

If you're reading this, I just want you to know you're always welcome back home. Please, learn from my mistake, and don't stay away forever.

Missing you,
XOXOXO
Mom

itm_04006aba.summary: Espionage Debriefing is a note / holotape in Point Lookout (value 0 caps). Available across Point Lookout locations and merchants.
itm_04006aba.text:
Agent Jiang; as you know, an important Chinese surveillance vessel was lost in American waters.
Your mission is to destroy derelict submarine SSN-37-1A before the Americans can recover and analyze it.
The recovery location is included in this dossier, and your cover ensures that the Americans will allow you access to their recovery operation.
However; you will need an authorization code to trigger the self-destruct sequence.
One of our field operatives in your area, Agent Yang, has these codes hidden in a dental capsule, but her current whereabouts are unknown.
Locate and rendezvous with Agent Yang, then destroy the submarine. Report to your safehouse for extraction information when the mission is complete.
The will of the People protect you, Agent Jiang.

sections.title: Location
sections.text: Inside safety deposit box 1207 in the People's Bank of Point Lookout. The holotape Box 1207 - Spy's audio password needs to be played in the bank vault to open the deposit box.
