sections.text: Rewards: Companion Jericho (armed with a Chinese Assault Rifle with infinite 5.56mm ammo; Small Guns specialist); Strong early-game combat support for characters with Evil Karma. Key participants: Jericho.

qst_000371d2.summary: Buy out the contract of ghoul bodyguard Charon at The Ninth Circle in Underworld: armed with a uniquely accurate shotgun, the fearless enforcer obeys whoever holds his employment contract, regardless of Karma.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Visit The Ninth Circle bar in the ghoul city of Underworld (inside the Museum of History on The Mall) and speak with bartender Ahzrukhal. Primary locations: The Ninth Circle.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Permanent companion Charon (follows you regardless of Karma!); Charon's unique long-range Combat Shotgun and knife, plus whatever you loot from Ahzrukhal's body. Key participants: Charon, Ahzrukhal.

qst_000173d9.summary: Daily operations and freeform assignments inside the Brotherhood of Steel Citadel (the Pentagon ruins): turning in fallen soldiers' Holotags to Scribe Elizabeth Jameson, browsing Knight Captain Dusk's armory, visiting Sawbones in the clinic, and reading archive terminals.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Gain access to the Citadel during the main quest "The Waters of Life" (MQ05). Primary locations: Citadel - B Ring, Citadel - A Ring.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: 100 caps and +5 Good Karma for every Brotherhood of Steel Holotag delivered to Scribe Jameson; Access to Knight Captain Dusk's armory, Sawbones's medical services, and unique Brotherhood archive terminals. Key participants: Knight Captain Gallows, Sawbones.

qst_000173d8.summary: A collection of unmarked Freeform Quests around Megaton: repairing leaking pipes for engineer Walter, trading Scrap Metal indefinitely, exposing Leo Stahl's chem stash, and settling affairs among townsfolk like Billy Creel and Maggie.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Speak with Walter at the Megaton Water Processing Plant, Leo Stahl at The Brass Lantern, or other townsfolk at any time before potentially detonating the bomb. Primary locations: Common House, Small Ranch, Water Processing Plant.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: 200 caps for repairing 3 pipes + unlimited Scrap Metal buyouts from Walter (10 caps and 5 XP per piece!); Key to Leo Stahl's chem stash at the Water Processing Plant and Good Karma; Ongoing discounts from Moira Brown and Doc Church when on good terms with the town. Key participants: Silver, Walter, Megaton Settler.

qst_000173d1.summary: Field encounters and skirmishes across the ruined districts of Washington, D.C.: rescuing Brotherhood of Steel Initiate Peabody in Falls Church, clearing a fortified super mutant stronghold, and backing up Lyons' Pride patrols on The Mall.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Exit the Metro into the Falls Church ruins (en route to Galaxy News Radio) or explore central Washington, D.C. Primary locations: Citadel - Laboratory, Citadel - B Ring, Citadel - A Ring, Arlington Public Library Lobby, DC Ruins Sector DC15a (Grayditch — Anchorage Memorial), DC Ruins Sector DC15a (Citadel Outer Perimeter).

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Ammo (5.56mm rounds, Microfusion Cells, and Stimpaks) from rescued Brotherhood of Steel soldiers; Salvaged Power Armor and heavy weapons from fallen combatants in urban firefights. Key participants: Star Paladin Cross, Paladin Tristan, Paladin Bael, Scribe Vallincourt, Scribe Yearling, Sawbones.

qst_00014ea5.summary: A rescue operation for the elite mercenary squad Reilly's Rangers: three troopers are pinned down by super mutants on the roof of the Statesman Hotel, while their leader Reilly lies in a coma in Underworld.

sections.title: Obtaining the quest
sections.text:
This quest can be started by:
• Finding Reilly in Underworld, the ghoul city situated in the Museum of History in D.C. (near the Washington Monument). She is lying unconscious in the Underworld hospital, The Chop Shop. One must either convince Doctor Barrows to wake her (Speech 78), or do so oneself (Medicine 60). Reilly explains that she was wounded by super mutants while trying to ex-filtrate and get help for her team, who are stranded on the roof of the Statesman Hotel. (Speaking to Reilly is the only way to learn about the optional quest involving Theo's ammunition cache since she is the only one who knows the code to unlock it.)
• Picking up the Ranger emergency frequency, an automated distress call from Rangers stranded on the roof of the Statesman Hotel.

sections.title: The Rangers
sections.text:
Reilly's Rangers are a mercenary group operating in the Capital Wasteland. Their current missions are the ongoing eradication of super mutants and mapping the Wasteland. The five members of Reilly's Rangers are:
• Reilly: leader of the Rangers.
• Donovan: the Rangers' Engineer.
• Brick: the Rangers' heavy weapons specialist, who uses a unique minigun named Eugene.
• Butcher: the Rangers' Medic.
• Theo: the Rangers' Quartermaster, who was carrying most of the Rangers' ammunition when he was killed in action.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
- Pre-quest preparations:
- Take at least one fission battery.
- Travel to Underworld to get the ammunition cache code from Reilly.
- Locate the Our Lady of Hope Hospital in Vernon Square. Note that contrary to what Reilly says, the dry sewer cannot be reached from Dupont Station, but rather from Dupont Circle East.
- Getting to the Statesman Hotel:
- One needs to make their way through the hospital and up to the second floor. This will require fighting or sneaking past the super mutants and one of the game's several centaurs. There is at least one pressure plate and several tripwire-activated grenade bouquets, set by the Rangers.
- Cross over to the Statesman Hotel by walking across the toppled crane. Drop down into the hotel.

qst_00014ea4.summary: Elderly violinist Agatha asks you to find a legendary Stradivarius violin in Vault 92 so she can resume broadcasting classical music over the radio.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Meeting Agatha:
Agatha's house is northeast of Meresti trainyard and west of the Scrapyard, and is surrounded by piles of rock, except for the small passage from the west over a wood suspension bridge. This bridge is located just west of where the two sets of upraised monorail tracks become parallel to each other.

Agatha is an elderly violinist who broadcasts her music through her late husband's old radio gear. She wants to get back the Soil Stradivarius, which was owned by her great-great-grandmother's sister Hilda. Agatha believes the violin is still in Vault 92, where the nation's best musicians were housed.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Speak with Agatha at her secluded home (east of Rockopolis / west of Scrapyard). Primary locations: Midship Deck, Meresti Trainyard, The Ninth Circle, Vault 92, Vault-Tec Corporate Offices, Sound Testing.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Agatha's Station (a radio station playing violin music); Unique Blackhawk revolver (if you bring sheet music paper from Vault 92 and ask for a reward!). Key participants: Abraham Washington, Ahzrukhal, Agatha, Masterbrain.

qst_00014ea3.summary: Returning home to Vault 101: some time after James's death, your Pip-Boy picks up an emergency radio broadcast from Amata, pleading for help to stop the Overseer's tyranny and civil strife.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest will be available 14 in-game days after completing The Waters of Life and is initiated by picking up the Vault 101 distress signal on the radio. To find it, simply wander near Vault 101. The signal is only active for a limited time; if the quest is not started before the signal stops, the only way to start it is through the console.

The radio signal is a repeating message from Amata asking the Lone Wanderer to return to Vault 101 to help stop her father, the overseer. If Alphonse Almodovar was killed while escaping from Vault 101, Allen Mack will be the new overseer; however, the radio message changes to "...the new Overseer is insane.

sections.title: Solutions
sections.text:
Although there are only three different outcomes, there are plenty of ways to finish each, but regardless of the path the Lone Wanderer chooses they will ultimately be banished from the Vault.

Keep the Vault closed:
There are essentially two ways to keep the vault closed; one way is to ignore the problem and leave. The downside to this is no quest-related rewards will be given.
• Simply ignore the radio message: The signal will cease after a while and the opportunity to gain XP (plus the modified utility jumpsuit) dissipate.
• Just enter Vault 101 once: Talk to some people and/or take items (such as opening the safe in James' office) and then exit the vault. After leaving, it will not be possible to reenter the vault as it has been locked again.

qst_00014ea2.summary: Rivet City museum curator Abraham Washington asks you to retrieve the original Declaration of Independence from the National Archives, racing ahead of mercenary Sydney.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Acquiring the quest:
Talk to Abraham Washington in Rivet City or go directly to the National Archives and enter the rotunda on the first floor.

Encountering Sydney:
Upon entering the rotunda, the Lone Wanderer will find Sydney, another treasure hunter sent by Abraham Washington to get the Declaration of Independence but never returned.

If one decides to help her by fending off the super mutants, they can take her on as a companion through to the end of the quest. However, if one declines to take her on as a companion, Sydney might appear later in a random encounter, "Seeking revenge for declining her offer."

Sydney can be completely avoided. By entering the back door of the National Archives, one can bypass the rotunda and retrieve the Declaration of Independence. Upon returning to the rotunda, Sydney will not be there.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
• Schematics - railway rifle
• 400 bottle caps - If Sydney was not encountered, her offer was declined, or she did not survive.
• Sydney's 10mm "Ultra" SMG - If one finishes her quest by giving the "My Little Moonbeam" holotape.

qst_00014ea1.summary: Mister Crowley in Underworld puts out a hit on 4 ghoul-haters (Dave, Dukov, Strayer, and Tenpenny) — but his true objective is their special keys to a secret cache at Fort Constantine!

sections.title: Background
sections.text: Allistair Tenpenny once hired five mercenaries: Mister Crowley, Tara, Dave, Dukov, and Jeff Strayer to find a rare weapon in Fort Constantine. In order to get a bigger share of the reward, Dukov trapped Mister Crowley (a ghoul) in a room with feral ghouls. Crowley, who survived despite what everyone else believed, is now a resident of Underworld. Tara died in Fort Constantine and the three remaining mercenaries escaped and completed the mission.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Starting the quest:
Talk to Mister Crowley in the Ninth Circle or at Carol's Place in Underworld, but do not insult him when you first speak to him or he will not give the quest. His task involves finding and killing Dave (at the Republic of Dave), Ted Strayer (in Rivet City), Dukov (at Dukov's Place), and Allistair Tenpenny (at Tenpenny Tower). He says they are ghoul-haters, and he wants them each killed with a shot to the head (as zombies are killed in fiction). For that purpose, he will give the Lone Wanderer a sniper rifle and five.308 caliber rounds. Crowley offers 100 caps per death by headshot with the sniper rifle as payment. He says that "word will get around" if Tenpenny is killed, but he wants proof for the others: "something personal...

qst_00014ea0.summary: A Paradise Falls slaver contract: gatekeeper Grouse issues an experimental hypnotizing emitter, the Mesmetron, along with slave collars to capture four Capital Wasteland residents.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
VIP List:
The characters that have to be enslaved for the slavers are the following:
• Flak from Rivet City.
• Red from Big Town.
• Susan Lancaster from Tenpenny Tower.
• Arkansas from Minefield.

If Red, Susan, or Arkansas are dead before the quest is given, they will not appear on the list and Grouse will allow the Lone Wanderer to enter Paradise Falls.

Arkansas:
Arkansas is sniping from a ruined building in Minefield. One should be careful as they make their way through the town, as land mines are scattered all over the town. Arkansas will also snipe and shoot at cars, which can explode and kill the Lone wanderer. Once he is collared, mind the mines for him as he starts running for Paradise Falls (fast travel is an option).

Susan Lancaster:
Susan Lancaster may be found on the third floor of Tenpenny Tower in her suite (at night).

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Speak with gatekeeper Grouse at the Paradise Falls gate (north of Arefu) and agree to complete the trial contract to gain entry to the camp. Primary locations: Wasteland, Upper Deck, Tenpenny Suites, DC Ruins Sector DC14d (L'Enfant Plaza — Anacostia), Big Town, Red's Clinic.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Unique hypnotic weapon Mesmetron and its ammunition; 250 caps per delivered captive (1,000 caps total) + unrestricted access to Paradise Falls. Key participants: Red, Flak, Grouse, Susan Lancaster, Arkansas, Slaver.

qst_00014e9f.summary: A heated conflict over the luxury skyscraper Tenpenny Tower: sentient ghouls led by former policeman Roy Phillips demand the right to live in the tower, while owner Allistair Tenpenny and security chief Gustavo seek to wipe them out.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
The ghouls of Warrington trainyard want to live in the luxurious Tenpenny Tower, but neither Allistair Tenpenny nor the other residents are willing to let them in. The player character can choose to kill the band of ghouls, help them force their way into the tower with the aid of their feral brethren, or find an uneasy diplomatic solution. The decisions made in this quest can have permanent and major effects on the fate of a major settlement and obtaining some of the most useful items in the game.

Starting the quest:
The quest is started either by speaking with Chief Gustavo at Tenpenny Tower or with Roy Phillips in the Warrington tunnels.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Approach the front gate of Tenpenny Tower in the southwest of the map and listen to Roy Phillips' argument over the intercom, then speak with Chief Gustavo. Primary locations: Wasteland, Tenpenny Tower Lobby, Tenpenny Suites, Warrington Station, Penthouse Suites, Metro Access & Generator.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Unique Ghoul Mask (makes ALL feral ghouls in the game completely friendly — reward from Roy Phillips!); 500–700 caps from Chief Gustavo (for eliminating the ghouls at Warrington Station). Key participants: Mister Burke, Allistair Tenpenny, Security Guard, Roy Phillips, Susan Lancaster, Herbert "Daring" Dashwood.

qst_00014e9e.summary: The fate of Megaton: disarm the unexploded atomic bomb in the center of the crater for Sheriff Lucas Simms, or rig it with a fusion pulse charge for Tenpenny's agent Mr. Burke.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest is given by:
• Sheriff Lucas Simms: The sheriff wants the Lone Wanderer to disarm the nuclear bomb in the middle of Megaton. Lucas will at first offer 100 caps, but Speech can be used to raise it to a total of 500 caps.
• Mister Burke: Burke wants the bomb detonated, as his employer, Allistair Tenpenny, considers Megaton a blight on the landscape of the Capital Wasteland. Burke can be found in Moriarty's Saloon in Megaton, sitting in the corner. A Speech check can be used for a chance to increase the payment for detonating the bomb by 500 caps (total of 1,000) or the Black Widow perk (player character must be female) to guarantee a raise of 500 caps.
• The quest can also be started by activating the bomb (25 Explosives Skill) and disarming it.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
If the bomb is disarmed:
• Bottle caps
• 500 - If Speech was successful at the start of the quest
• 100 - If the offer is accepted, Speech failed, or unemployed at the start of the quest
• My Megaton house key
• Deed: My Megaton house
• 300 XP
• Karma [+200]: If the bomb is disarmed for free
• A contract for extermination will be put out by Mister Burke or Allistair Tenpenny and Talon Company will start hunting the player character.

If Megaton is destroyed:
• Bottle caps
• 1000 - If Speech was successful at the start of the quest, or if the Black Widow perk was taken and unique dialogue is chosen
• 500 - If the offer is accepted or Speech failed
• My Tenpenny Tower suite key
• Deed: Tenpenny Tower suite
• 300 XP
• Karma [-1,000]: If Megaton is destroyed
• Regulators will start hunting the player character.

qst_00014e9c.summary: The settlement of Arefu is being terrorized by a gang called The Family, and Lucy West from Megaton asks you to deliver a letter to her relatives — Evan King and the West family.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Quest start:
The quest can be started by speaking with Lucy West in or around Moriarty's Saloon in Megaton, by talking to Evan King in Arefu, by reading "Regarding the Arefu Incident" in the Family's terminal in the Meresti Metro Station, or by overhearing a conversation between members of the Family.

Deliver Lucy's Message:
Lucy West asks the Lone Wanderer to deliver a letter to her family in Arefu. If the quest is accepted, Lucy will give the player character an envelope, and mark the location of Arefu on the Lone Wanderer's Pip-Boy 3000.

Report to Evan King:
Evan King will toss a grenade as the player character approaches Arefu. King then apologizes and explains that the town has been under repeated attacks by The Family.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Speak with Lucy West at Moriarty's Saloon or in Megaton. Primary locations: Wasteland, Meresti Metro Station, Meresti Trainyard, Meresti Service Tunnel, Evan King's House, Lucy West's House.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Schematics - Shishkebab; Hematophage perk (Blood Packs restore 20 HP); Protection for Arefu and peace with Ian West. Key participants: Lucy West, Grouse, Vance, Robert, Holly, Karl.

qst_00014e9b.summary: A detective investigation for the Commonwealth's Institute: Doctor Zimmer is hunting a runaway android designated A3-21, hiding in the Capital Wasteland under a new identity.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Starting the quest:
The quest is given to the player character by Dr. Zimmer in Rivet City, who tasks the Lone Wanderer to track down an android that has escaped. The android has gone independent and does not wish to return. Alternatively, the quest can also be started by finding one of the Replicated Man holotapes.
The quest can also be started when approached by Victoria, who asks the player character to stop asking so many questions and later tells them about an android who thinks he is human.

Find more clues:
After the quest has started, three more clues need to be found. Generally, these are tied to certain non-player characters with two options to obtain a clue from each of those people: through dialogue or by finding a holotape/terminal in the person's possession or room.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Speak with Doctor Zimmer in the Rivet City Science Lab (or find the holotape 'An Android's Story'). Primary locations: Wasteland, Upper Deck, Tenpenny Tower Lobby, Midship Deck, Citadel - B Ring, Underworld Concourse.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: A3-21's Plasma Rifle (from Harkness); Wired Reflexes perk (+10% V.A.T.S. accuracy, from Zimmer); Both rewards can be obtained in a single playthrough!. Key participants: Doctor Li, Red, Belle Bonny, Harkness, Victoria Watts, Seagrave Holmes.

qst_00014e99.summary: Showdown over the Lincoln Memorial: escaped slaves from the Temple of the Union led by Hannibal Hamlin want to restore the monument, while slavers under Leroy Walker aim to seize it.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Talking with the Union:
The quest is given to the Lone Wanderer in the Temple of the Union by Hannibal Hamlin. Hannibal wants to relocate his slave haven from the Temple of the Union to the Lincoln Memorial and restore the Memorial as a sign of freedom, despite the fact that it would undoubtedly attract unwanted attention. The quest may also be started after speaking with Leroy Walker or killing the slavers at the Lincoln Memorial.

Hannibal requests for the player character to scout the Lincoln Memorial to see if it is still occupied by super mutants. He will also ask the player character to assist former slave Caleb Smith. Caleb is a stonemason, and will ask the player character to obtain a poster of the Lincoln Memorial in the Museum of History so that he will have reference material to help him restore the Lincoln Memorial.

sections.title: Selling Lincoln's artifacts
sections.text:
The eight Lincoln artifacts can be sold either to Hannibal Hamlin, Leroy Walker, or Abraham Washington.

Selling at least one artifact to Leroy Walker will grant one access to the memorial without being shot. Just ask him if one can peek around the memorial.

qst_00014e98.summary: Collector Sierra Petrovita is searching for 30 bottles of rare glowing Nuka-Cola Quantum in exchange for the Nuka-Grenade recipe.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Take Sierra's Nuka-Cola tour:
To start this quest, find Sierra Petrovita at Girdershade, which is located northwest of Jocko's Pop & Gas stop and southwest of Smith Casey's garage.

Upon greeting the Lone Wanderer, she offers to give the "Nuka-Cola tour," which consists of viewing the large number of Nuka-Cola collectibles she owns. If the Lone Wanderer agrees to take the tour, she will show them around her home, discuss various Nuka-Cola facts and talk about some of the items in the room. The tour can be paused after each exhibit, as Sierra won't move unless the player moves more than the camera. After the tour, she gives the Lone Wanderer an ice cold Nuka-Cola. Immediately after the tour, she'll talk about the Nuka-Cola Quantum.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
• Sierra pays for the Nuka-Cola Quantums (40 caps each). Once given enough to fill her Nuka-Cola vending machine, she rewards the Lone Wanderer with Schematics - Nuka grenade and +300 XP. In the future, she will also make a Mississippi Quantum pie if the right ingredients are brought to her.
• Giving the bottles to Ronald Laren results in a loss of Karma and double the caps (80 caps each) if the Speech check succeeded, otherwise it remains 40 caps for each. Once the quest is complete (30 have been handed over), he goes to Sierra's house straight away and starts making moves only to have Sierra completely misunderstand his advances.

qst_00014e97.summary: Mystery of the giant fire ants in Grayditch: young Bryan Wilks asks you to rescue his father and uncover where the mutants came from.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
During the first two stages of the mission, Bryan will be hiding in the Pulowski Preservation shelter near the diner.

Find Bryan Wilks's father:
Bryan Wilks will approach the Lone Wanderer in the area outside Grayditch, where he tells them that he, his father, and the other dwellers were attacked by fire ants. He then asks the player character to look for his father in the town. The father's body can be later found in his house by the shack, killed by the fire ants. The player character can loot a Chinese assault rifle and some ammunition off the shelf in the house and the shack's key from the body of Bryan's father. In the shack, the player can find Doctor Lesko's equipment and terminal. Read the notes on the terminal to receive the Marigold station location and the option to proceed there to locate the source of the fire ants.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
• Lesko's lab coat
• Ant Might OR Ant Sight perk
• 300 XP
• Good Karma if Bryan is sent to Rivet City
• Neutral Karma if Bryan is sent to Little Lamplight or left alone in Grayditch
• Evil Karma if Bryan is sent to Paradise Falls

qst_00014e96.summary: An extensive 3-chapter research quest (3 tasks per chapter) for Craterside Supply: Moira Brown is writing the definitive guide to surviving the Wasteland.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text: Moira Brown, the owner of Craterside Supply in Megaton, wants someone to do some dangerous research for a book she is writing entitled The Wasteland Survival Guide. Though each chapter is generally a unique quest, they all share common attributes for their rewards. All non-unique item rewards are given in a quantity proportionate to the Lone Wanderer's level, meaning the player character will receive more of some items at higher levels. The player character is also given dialogue options based on which of their SPECIAL stats are at least 7: the more stats at 7 or higher, the more dialogue options. The player character's dialogue options affect both the style of the book and the specific rewards at the end of the quest.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Speak with Moira Brown at Craterside Supply in Megaton. Primary locations: Upper Deck, Midship Deck, Arlington Public Library Lobby, Offices and Cafeteria, Broken Bow, Tepid Sewer.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Survival Expert perk (bonuses depend on dialogue tone and optional objectives); Plenty of caps, Stimpaks, grenades, and store discounts; Ranger Hat / Armor and 1,000+ XP total. Key participants: Doctor Li, Belle Bonny, Harkness, Seagrave Holmes, Flak, Garza.

qst_00014e95.summary: A clash of two eccentric "superheroes" in Canterbury Commons: inventor Scott Wollinski in Mechanist armor commanding robots fights orphan Tanya Christoff as the AntAgonizer leading giant ants.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
The town of Canterbury Commons has become the battleground of a "supervillain"—the AntAgonizer and a "superhero"—the Mechanist. Its inhabitants are not very happy about it (save for Derek Pacion) and ask the Lone Wanderer if they can help them.

Upon arriving in Canterbury Commons, the AntAgonizer and the Mechanist will be engaged in a standoff. After a few scripted opening semantics, the two will engage in a brawl. Once the dust clears, both will run away, and Uncle Roe will speak to the player character, asking them to handle the ordeal. With a speech check, One can ask for double the pay, from 200 to 400 caps. After accepting the quest, speak to Derek Pacion. He provides the best info on where to find them.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
• 200 caps (Stopping one of them)
OR
• 400 caps (Stopping both, or asking with the Speech skill to be paid 400 and stop one)
OR
• 600 caps (Stopping both after asking for 400 caps with the Speech skill)

qst_00014e94.summary: Saving the residents of Big Town: grown-up exiles from Little Lamplight are besieged by Super Mutants, who have kidnapped their doctor Red and hunter Shorty to Germantown Police HQ.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Big Town residents have been attacked by super mutants, who capture residents and have recently taken them to Germantown Police HQ, including Red, the town doctor. The quest can be started by speaking with any of the town's residents, speaking with Sticky in Little Lamplight, or if the player character talks to Red in Germantown Police HQ.

Rescue:
Germantown police HQ has two possible entrances: the first is using the higher door on the north side. If the player character has 100 Lockpick, the lower door on the west side may also be entered and puts them very close to Red's location. If the former is chosen, some hallways of super mutants and the occasional trap need to be traversed.

Red is located in a jail cell on the ground floor.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
If Red survives:
• 300 XP
• 300 caps OR good Karma
OR
• 500 caps + bad Karma by passing a Speech check
• With either option, Red will still offer healing services and Pappy will offer repair services.

If Red dies:
• 200 caps

Timebomb healed/super mutant attack repelled:
• Lucky 8 ball

qst_00014e93.summary: The moral climax of the main story inside the Jefferson Memorial rotunda: deciding what to do with the modified FEV vial given to you by President Eden at Raven Rock.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Once the Lone Wanderer approaches the entrance of the Jefferson Memorial as required by the related main quest Take it Back!, this quest will activate soon after. The exact objective outlined is: "Infect the Project Purity water supply... or not."

The player can choose to infect the water supply with the modified FEV given to them by President Eden once inside of the rotunda which will complete this quest immediately after. This is done via the purifier's console just to the right of the entrance to the purifier's primary chamber.

Should one choose to not infect the water, the quest will fail. It grants no XP upon its completion and the modified FEV will remove itself from the player character's inventory regardless of their choice in infecting the water or not.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Activates automatically after receiving the modified FEV vial from President John Henry Eden during "The American Dream". Primary locations: Jefferson Memorial Rotunda, DC Ruins Sector DC10b (Jefferson Memorial).

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: +250 Good Karma for handing the FEV vial over to Elder Lyons; Alternate ending slides and major consequences for drinking water in Broken Steel.

qst_00014e91.summary: The final battle for the Capital Wasteland: the towering combat robot Liberty Prime's march to the Jefferson Memorial, a final showdown with Colonel Autumn, and activating Project Purity.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Attack!:
When the Lone Wanderer reaches the Citadel, Owyn Lyons will be briefing his daughter Sarah and Lyons' Pride, in preparation for an assault on the purifier. After informing them of the situation, Sarah's squad is mobilized to wrest control of the purifier from the Enclave. Liberty Prime is activated despite the objections of Scribe Rothchild, who demands it not be used and declares "...it's not ready for field tests, let alone live fire situations - the weapons haven't been calibrated, the navigation detection system is offline..." Despite his warnings, Prime is launched and used without any malfunctions.

To begin the advance on the Jefferson Memorial, one must speak with Sarah Lyons. Note that once the order to attack has been given the green light, all functions, and services in the Citadel will cease.

sections.title: Ending
sections.text: The ending varies depending on how the player plays the game, and some of the largest differences are seen depending on what the player has done during Take it Back! See Fallout 3 endings for more info.

qst_00014e90.summary: Cut main quest "Infiltration" preserved in the Fallout3.esm base game files between escaping Raven Rock and the final assault "Take it Back!": a covert dive into a flooded hold of Rivet City to recover a prototype power source for Liberty Prime.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
Based on surviving quest stages, the player character was supposed to enter Rivet City through an underwater hatch, acquire the energy source of "the prototype" and return it to Scribe Rothchild in the Citadel. The latest remaining quest stage indicates that the player character was then to meet Elder Lyons in his study.

The quest's editor ID is MQ10. The prefix MQ designates Infiltration as a main quest, and the number places it between The American Dream (MQ09) and Take it Back! (MQ11).

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: In the retail release, this quest is disabled in the story script after "The American Dream" and can only be accessed via game archives or console commands.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Prototype power source to bring the giant robot Liberty Prime online; Access to the final briefing with Elder Owyn Lyons before "Take it Back!".

qst_00014e8f.summary: Interrogation by Colonel Autumn inside the Enclave base at Raven Rock, a face-to-face meeting with President John Henry Eden (a ZAX supercomputer), and escaping with the modified FEV.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
The Lone Wanderer awakens behind a force field, in a prison cell inside Raven Rock, the Enclave hideout located in the very northwest corner of the map. Colonel Autumn wants the access code to Project Purity and there are a few different responses to give him:
• One can give Autumn the true code, 2-1-6, and he thanks the player character by executing them.
• Refuse the Colonel in a most impolite manner, infuriating him by saying "Fuck you."
• Play dumb, which also makes the Colonel angry and state "You lie!"
• One may tell the Colonel that the code is 7-0-4. An Enclave officer at the purifier will test this and get one of his men killed. This is by far the most infuriating response one can give Colonel Autumn.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Starts automatically after being captured at the end of "Finding the Garden of Eden". Primary locations: Wasteland, Citadel - Laboratory, Citadel - B Ring, Citadel - A Ring, Vault 101 Lower Level, The Muddy Rudder Bar.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: 700 XP; Modified FEV vial (optional); Energy Weapons Bobblehead (DO NOT MISS IT!). Key participants: Butch, Charon, Star Paladin Cross, Sentinel Lyons, Jericho, Clover.

qst_00014e8e.summary: Exploring the irradiated laboratories of Vault 87, meeting the intelligent Super Mutant Fawkes, retrieving the G.E.C.K., and being captured by the Enclave.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Enter Vault 87:
Depending on your choice during Picking Up the Trail, you either have to fight your way through Murder Pass to the vault door and enter or talk to Joseph in order to hack the terminal to enter Vault 87.

Find a G.E.C.K.:
Both entrances of Vault 87 lead to the Reactor Chamber. From there, you proceed to the Living Quarters, then the Test Labs. There, you eventually encounter and liberate a super mutant named Fawkes who asks to hold a conversation with you over the intercom. Fawkes explains his upbringing in the vault and how he has become intelligible and civilized through continued access to the vault's database. Fawkes promises to retrieve the Garden of Eden Creation Kit from the irradiated halls above if he is released.

The radiation level where the G.E.C.K. is stored is extremely high.

sections.title: Followers
sections.text:
If you are accompanied by a companion, they will not be with you after you have been incapacitated by the Enclave. Be sure to retrieve any equipment from them you do not want them to walk off with (as if they were fired) before this happens, or right after retrieving the G.E.C.K. You will not have a chance to re-hire your companion until after The American Dream. After re-hiring a companion they will have all the items you left with them still in their inventory, so it can be a good way to free up inventory space of non-essential items you want but won't need during your time in Raven Rock, allowing you to stock up on the mountains of Enclave gear.
• Butch DeLoria will return to The Muddy Rudder in Rivet City. Butch will not follow you if your Karma strays from Neutral.

qst_00014e8d.summary: Infiltrating the slaver camp of Paradise Falls to rescue the kidnapped children from Little Lamplight.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text: When inside Paradise Falls, the Lone Wanderer will have to go to the slave cage at the back of the area and talk to the kids through the wire gate (or kill Carter before his slave collar is activated and talk to Sammy nearby, thus starting the quest; however, killing Carter turns the slavers hostile). Squirrel tells the player character that they must get his computer terminal reconnected to the network so he can deactivate their slave collars and open the gates. This can be accomplished either by tampering with the terminal in Eulogy's pad (requires 50 science) or rewiring a cable junction box near the bar (the area with the sign labeled "Food") (requires Repair 40). Once this is completed, Squirrel then advises that the guard Forty needs to be distracted so they can make a run for it.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Speak with Mayor MacCready in Little Lamplight. Primary locations: Wasteland, Eulogy's Pad.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: 500 XP; Access to Vault 87 via Murder Pass or the reactor room. Key participants: Eulogy Jones, Forty, Crimson, Carter, Rory Maclaren, Sammy.

qst_00014e8c.summary: Searching the Citadel archives for information on the G.E.C.K. and finding a way into Vault 87 either through lethally irradiated ground or the children's town of Little Lamplight.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Escort Doctor Li inside the Citadel.:
Picking Up the Trail begins after Doctor Li speaks to Elder Lyons through the intercom, and the front gate to the Citadel is opened. The first objective is straightforward; escort Dr. Li inside the Citadel. There is no fighting, just follow her through the door to the Citadel courtyard, which is directly across from the front gate. Upon entering the courtyard, Elder Lyons approaches and Dr. Li speaks with him about Project Purity and what recently transpired, and requests his help. At this point, Dr. Li and the three men that were being escorted are no longer in the Lone Wanderer's care, and the objective is completed. It is now possible to ask Elder Lyons for permission to begin training to wear power armor, and he will consent.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Complete "The Waters of Life" at the Citadel. Primary locations: Upper Deck, Citadel - Laboratory, Citadel - B Ring, Citadel - A Ring, Lamplight Caverns, Little Lamplight Office Building.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: 500 XP; Information about Vault 87. Key participants: Doctor Li, Elder Lyons, Scribe Rothchild, Mayor MacCready, Lucy, Princess.

qst_00014e8b.summary: Returning to Rivet City, restarting the purifier at the Jefferson Memorial, a sudden Enclave assault, and James's tragic sacrifice. Evacuating the scientists to the Citadel.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Go to the Rivet City science lab and join the scientists at Project Purity:
James will make his way to Rivet City; the Lone Wanderer can choose to follow him there or leave him on his own, either way, he will eventually reach the Rivet City science lab and wait for the player character to meet him there.

Upon the player character's arrival, James convinces Dr. Li to reactivate Project Purity. After a short conversation, he asks the player character to meet him and the scientists at the Jefferson Memorial. It is highly advised to stock up and prepare for a battle, as well as free up as much inventory space as possible.

Characters:
Named characters who relocate to the Jefferson Memorial:

Clear Project Purity of any remaining mutant threat:
Dr.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Starts immediately after freeing your father from Vault 112. Primary locations: Wasteland, Upper Deck, Citadel - B Ring, Vault 101 Lower Level, Taft Tunnel, Memorial Sub-Basement.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: 600 XP; Access to the Brotherhood of Steel Citadel; Power Armor (unlocks Power Armor Training in the Citadel). Key participants: Butch, Charon, Sentinel Lyons, Jericho, Clover, Doctor Li.

qst_00014e8a.summary: Dr. Braun's virtual reality simulation "Tranquility Lane": finding your father turned into a dog, and choosing between Betty's sadistic tasks or activating the "Chinese Invasion" failsafe.

sections.title: Summary
sections.text:
Tranquility Lane is a virtual reality simulation housed in Vault 112, created by Dr. Stanislaus Braun. The Lone Wanderer is tasked with an escalating series of violent tasks ranging from making a child cry to killing residents. The tasks are given by a little girl named Betty, who in turn will free the Lone Wanderer's father, James, who is trapped in dog form.

As an alternative to completing the violent tasks, the player character may activate a failsafe, which will irrevocably kill everyone with the exception of Betty, James, and the Lone Wanderer. Both solutions result in the release of the Lone Wanderer and their father from the simulation.

Residents:
The following are the residents that live in Tranquility Lane:

Betty's tasks:
Betty will task the Lone Wanderer to do the following:
- Make Timmy cry:
- * By attacking him physically.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Reach Smith Casey's Garage, descend into Vault 112, and sit in a VR Tranquility Lounger. Primary locations: Wasteland, Citadel - Laboratory, Citadel - A Ring, Vault 101 Lower Level, Test Labs, Vault 112.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: 500 XP; Rescuing your father (James); "Tranquility Lane" achievement/trophy. Key participants: Butch, Charon, Sentinel Lyons, Star Paladin Cross, Jericho, Clover.

qst_00014e89.summary: Meeting your father's colleague Dr. Madison Li in Rivet City, an expedition to the Jefferson Memorial, and discovering James's trail leading to Vault 112.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest can be started by talking to Dr. Madison Li in the Rivet City science lab, with or without completing the Galaxy News Radio quest. Also, it can be started by picking up the notes in Jefferson Memorial regarding Project Purity, or by entering Vault 112 itself.

It is highly likely that one has already visited Rivet City, likely as part of the Wasteland Survival Guide or in the course of visiting the southern Metro stations to reach areas like Museum of History or the National Archives. In this case, reaching Dr. Li is trivial.

The easiest - as in, quickest with the least combat - way to get to Rivet City is to go back via the map marker in your Pip-Boy 3000 to Super-Duper Mart.
• From there, follow the river (Potomac) south on the west bank, passing Wilhelm's Wharf, down to the Francis Scott Key Bridge at the Citadel.

sections.title: Achievement
sections.text:
It is possible to skip major portions of this quest, for example by speaking directly to Dr. Li in Rivet City before visiting Three Dog, or by visiting the Jefferson Memorial directly. In these cases, this achievement will still be rewarded at the same time that the Tranquility Lane achievement is received.

In the Xbox and PS3 versions, if one has already entered the Jefferson Memorial (especially the rotunda) before talking to Dr. Li in Rivet City, the achievement/trophy will not be unlocked once until the Lone Wanderer materializes at Tranquility Lane. Thus this achievement/trophy cannot be obtained out of sequence, with regards to the main quest achievements. In order to rectify this, the player character can load a saved game at a point where Jefferson Memorial has not been explored and work through the main quest again.

qst_00014e88.summary: Journey through ruined Metro tunnels to the Galaxy News Radio building, battle a Super Mutant Behemoth alongside Lyons' Pride, and recover a communications dish for the relay.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Quest start:
The quest may be given immediately after meeting Three Dog.

Completing the Megaton portion of the main storyline quest Following in His Footsteps, Three Dog will offer the Lone Wanderer information about their father in exchange for restoring the satellite relay dish for Galaxy News Radio. Accepting his offer to start the quest immediately, or failing the speech check, begins the quest on those terms.

Succeeding at the speech check makes this an optional quest, with the reward being the location of a weapons cache. The cache still exists if Three Dog does not give the information, and its location is near that of the Blood Ties quest, which can be started in Megaton.

Find the Museum of Technology:
Three Dog will give directions to (place map markers for) the Museum of Technology and the Washington Monument.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
• 400 XP
• Information about James' whereabouts.
• The player character can receive an additional reward if they finish this quest after discovering their father's whereabouts from someone other than Three Dog, or by using a successful Speech check to have him tell the player character where James is. In addition to good Karma, Three Dog gives the player character a note titled "the weapons cache," the key to the weapons cache and the map marker for Hamilton's hideaway where the cache is located. The cache is behind a cell door in the northwesternmost area of the hideaway, behind some rubble. It contains a Guns and Bullets, a mini nuke, a Stealth Boy, a leveled helmet and armor as well as other random loot.

qst_00014e87.summary: First steps into the Capital Wasteland: searching for your father leads you to the nearby town of Megaton and Moriarty's Saloon.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
NOTE: Where it says optional, it means the player character can skip the parts before it, like going straight to Smith Casey's garage will finish the quest and the player character will not have to go to Rivet City.

Megaton and '300 Pieces of Silver':
Objective: Investigate the nearby town of Megaton for information about James.

In Megaton, everyone will point the player character to the saloon owner, Colin Moriarty who will offer to tell you where your dad is if you give him 100 caps. If one does not accept the offer, he will ask for 300 the next time one talks to him. You can also use Speech to convince Moriarty that your father told you about him or choose certain dialogue options to get him to give the Lone Wanderer a discount, provided they agree to kill Silver and bring back the caps she stole.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Assigned automatically upon exiting Vault 101. Primary locations: Wasteland, Citadel - A Ring, GNR Studios, Museum of Technology West Wing, Small Ranch, Children of Atom.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: 200–300 XP; Information on your father's destination (Galaxy News Radio); Transition to the "Galaxy News Radio" quest. Key participants: Sentinel Lyons, Jericho, Paladin Vargas, Billy Creel, Three Dog, Colin Moriarty.

qst_00014e86.summary: Prologue climax: James has fled Vault 101, and the Overseer has sounded the alarm and killed Jonas. Fight your way to the main Vault door and step out into the Capital Wasteland.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
The quest begins with Amata frantically trying to wake the Lone Wanderer up. She informs them that their father has left Vault 101 and Jonas is dead. Every member of the vault security team has been ordered to attack the player character because the overseer thinks that they are aware of James's departure, and radroaches have infested the vault. Amata offers a 10mm pistol in perfect condition to the player character, which can be accepted or refused. If one refuses, Amata will keep the gun and use it against Officer Mack later. The player character may also become angry towards Amata, resulting in her remaining in the room. The player character may still leave, however.

Outside of the room, one will encounter Officer Kendall, who is being attacked by several radroaches.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Starts automatically after "Future Imperfect". Primary locations: Vault 101, Vault 101 Atrium, Vault 101 Entrance, Vault 101 Reactor Sub-Level.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: 10mm Pistol; Medicine Bobblehead (in Dad's office!); Tunnel Snakes Outfit; Access to the Capital Wasteland; Quest "Following in His Footsteps". Key participants: The Overseer, Amata, Stanley, Butch, Ellen DeLoria, Officer Richards.

qst_00014e85.summary: Sixteenth birthday: taking the G.O.A.T. exam, choosing three Tag Skills, and dealing with the Tunnel Snakes.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest takes place on August 3, 2274. After a talk with dad, the Lone Wanderer is told to go to class and take the G.O.A.T.. The Medicine bobblehead is on James' desk and this is one of only three opportunities to obtain it. Exiting dad's office, the player character will run into Jonas and also see Stanley who is suffering severe headaches and insomnia. Just outside the classroom, Amata is being harassed by Butch DeLoria and his gang, the Tunnel Snakes. There are a variety of choices that can be taken here:
• The player character may pass a Speech check warning Butch that the Overseer will come down on the Tunnel Snakes if he continues his actions. This will earn good Karma.
• Also for good Karma, Wally Mack may be convinced that he is being used by Butch as a lackey, which causes him and Paul Hannon to leave the group.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Starts automatically after "Growing Up Fast". Primary locations: Vault 101, Vault 101 Entrance.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: 3 Tag Skills (+15 to each). Key participants: Amata, Christine Kendall, Butch, Paul Hannon, Wally Mack, Mr. Brotch.

qst_00014e84.summary: Tenth birthday party in the Vault 101 cafeteria: first presents, meeting Amata and Butch, receiving your Pip-Boy 3000, and practicing with a BB Gun.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Have a present:
This quest begins immediately after the Baby Steps quest, though it occurs in 2268, at the player character's 10th birthday party. They will be congratulated and be given a Pip-Boy 3000.

Enjoy your party:
Goals:
* Talk to Amata
** Receive: Grognak the Barbarian issue #14
* Talk to Old Lady Palmer
** Receive: sweetroll
Optional:
* Talk to Stanley
** Text Choice: Any throughout conversation.
*** Receive: kid's baseball cap
* Talk to Beatrice
** Text Choice: Any throughout conversation.
*** Receive: A birthday poem (viewable in the Notes section of your Pip-Boy 3000)

The Lone Wanderer is to speak with the guests to advance the plot. There are really only two that must be spoken with, however. Amata will more than likely be the first to speak with them, with three different dialogue options.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Starts automatically after "Baby Steps". Primary locations: Vault 101.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Pip-Boy 3000; BB Gun; Security Baton; Sweetroll (or "Grognak the Barbarian" comic book). Key participants: Officer Kendall, Officer Gomez, Amata, Old Lady Palmer, The Overseer, Butch.

qst_00014e83.summary: Game prologue in Vault 101: the birth of the Lone Wanderer, choosing your appearance, and allocating your initial S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats at age 1.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Walk to dad:
Walk over to dad.

And talk to dad!

Escape the playpen:
After James speaks for a short while, he will lock his child in the playpen and leave. A new objective is given at this point: open the playpen's gate by walking up to it and activating it. Once the gate has swung open, it is time to learn how to grab and move objects around without adding them to the inventory by interacting with the nearby toy chest. Additionally, by approaching the chair next to the playpen, a prompt will appear with a quick tip on how to jump.

You're S.P.E.C.I.A.L.:
The next objective is to find the book "You're SPECIAL!" which is lying right in front of the toy chest. Once examined, a prompt will appear which will go over and determine what the starting primary statistics should be.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
• S.P.E.C.I.A.L. points assigned
• Progress to age 10

sections.title: Transition quotes
sections.text:
Full transition audio:
You may not be able to listen to all the voices talking at the same time during the transition from being a newborn to an infant. These are the lines:

qst_010034da.summary: Collecting all 10 secret Intel suitcases across the four stages of the Operation: Anchorage simulation to earn the permanent Covert Ops perk, along with field conversations with the War Correspondent and Dr. Adami.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Activates automatically upon picking up any Intel suitcase or speaking with U.S. base personnel inside the Operation: Anchorage simulation.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Unique "Covert Ops" perk (+3 Science, +3 Lockpick, +3 Sneak permanently!); Free healing from field medic Dr. Adami and wartime reports from the War Correspondent. Key participants: American War Correspondent, Doctor Adami, American Soldier, Chinese Sniper.

qst_010014f6.summary: The finale of the simulation — storming the pulse field compound and dueling General Jingwei. Returning to reality and surviving the mutiny among the Outcasts.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
The quest begins automatically after Paving the Way.

After destroying the Chimera fuel tanks and clearing the listening post of Chinese presence with the selected Strike team, the Lone Wanderer can now enter the heart of the map in order to disable the pulse field barring American power armored soldiers from attacking the Chinese base of operations.

Disable the Pulse Field:
This time, the player character has to make do without the assistance of their squad. Instead, Sergeant Montgomery alone accompanies the player character. The first line of the enemies' defense includes scattered mortar fire followed by deep trenches. Once down in the trenches the player character is confronted with various stealth units and snipers. After a while, the player character arrives at the final line of Chinese defense, the pulse field.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
Upon completion of Operation: Anchorage, the player character acquires the Power Armor Training perk if they don't have it already. In addition, the player character is granted access to an armory within the Outcast outpost.

This room contains several unique weapons and armors:
• Winterized T-51b power armor
• Winterized T-51b power helmet
• Chinese stealth armor
• Jingwei's shocksword
• Trench knife
• Gauss rifle

Along with other more common items, such as:

sections.title: Intel suitcases
sections.text:
The last 2 of the 10 intel suitcases required for gaining the Covert Ops perk can be found during this mission. Please refer to the main article for their locations.

It's also possible to return to the areas to get the cases from Paving the Way if they were missed.

qst_010009c0.summary: The sabotage phase of the liberation of Alaska from the U.S. Army field camp: selecting a weapon loadout, assembling your strike team with Lieutenant Morgan, and clearing the Listening Post and the Chimera Tank fuel depot.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
The quest will automatically begin after the completion of The Guns of Anchorage.

Listen to General Chase's briefing:
General Chase congratulates the Lone Wanderer on their success. They are promoted and put in charge of their own strike team (formerly led by the now-deceased Patterson). The general explains that 3 tasks have to be completed before the assault on the Chinese headquarters, a refinery, can begin. The player character has to destroy the fuel tanks at the enemy Chimera armor depot, clear a listening post of all Chinese presence, and disable "their damn pulse field." According to Chase, the player character should not try to disable the pulse field before they have completed the other assignments.

Chase then refers the player character to their intelligence officer for this mission, Lieutenant Morgan, for the details.

sections.title: Intel suitcases
sections.text: Four of the ten intel suitcases required for gaining the Covert Ops perk can be found during this mission, two on the way, and at the Chimera fuel depot as well as two on the way to or at the listening post. Refer to the main article for their locations.

qst_010009bf.summary: First combat operation of the virtual campaign in Alaska: a stealthy cliff ascent alongside Sergeant Benjamin Montgomery, infiltrating a Chinese artillery bunker and destroying three long-range guns.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
The main objective of the quest is to destroy a set of three artillery guns.

There are a total of 10 intel suitcases to be found in the 3 quests inside the simulator and all ten need to be found to gain the Covert Ops perk. These suitcases are usually slightly off the path or behind (very easy or easy) locked doors.

Infiltrate the Chinese artillery site:
The Lone Wanderer starts off at the Anchorage cliffs with Sergeant Montgomery waking them up. They are part of a U.S. paratrooper infiltration team, and the objective is to take out the artillery guns located here. To do this, the player must first infiltrate the Chinese artillery outpost. Montgomery then proceeds to climb up the cliffs.

Due to lack of climbing abilities, the player must take the long way. Follow the path to the right, and one will encounter a Chinese soldier.

sections.title: Intel suitcases
sections.text: 4 of the 10 intel suitcases required for gaining the Covert Ops perk can be found during this mission. Please refer to the main article for their locations.

qst_010009be.summary: An expedition to a Brotherhood Outcasts outpost at Bailey's Crossroads: assisting Defender Morrill's squad against super mutants and entering a pre-war military simulation of the Liberation of Anchorage to unlock a sealed armory.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Investigate the Outcast distress signal:
After installing the add-on, the Lone Wanderer receives a message about an Outcast distress signal, which automatically adds the quest to the Pip-Boy.

From the emergency signal, the Lone Wanderer learns that Defender Morrill is asking anybody capable of receiving the signal for support at Bailey's Crossroads. Bailey's Crossroads can be reached via Bailey's Crossroads Metro just northeast of the Red Racer factory. This is a fairly standard tunnel system occupied by a few feral ghouls.

Help the Outcast soldiers:
At Bailey's Crossroads, a battle is taking place between super mutants and Brotherhood Outcasts.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Pick up the Outcast Distress Signal on your Pip-Boy and travel to Bailey's Crossroads Metro in the southern Wasteland. Primary locations: Meresti Trainyard, Outcast Outpost, Raven Rock - Control Room, Agatha's House.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Outcast Neural Interface Suit; Access to the underground bunker and the Operation: Anchorage simulation pod. Key participants: Protector McGraw, Specialist Olin, Defender Sibley, Brotherhood Outcast, Defender Morrill.

qst_0200a358.summary: A side investigation in The Pitt: searching for a slave named Wild Bill who went missing in the abandoned mill of the Steelyard and recovering his unique silenced .32 caliber revolver.

sections.title: Walkthrough
sections.text:
Meeting Milly:
After speaking with Midea in her quarters as part of Unsafe Working Conditions, Milly, one of the Pitt slaves, can be found walking around beneath the catwalks in Downtown. Milly is worried about Wild Bill, another slave who has been missing since volunteering to search for ingots in the steelyard, and asks the Lone Wanderer to look for him.

Finding the Body:
As part of Unsafe Working Conditions, the player is sent into the steelyard to find ingots. While in the steelyard, Wild Bill's body can be found on a landing between two flights of stairs from the ground up to Wernher's hideout (see the gallery for a detailed map). His body is next to two steel ingots, and has his unique sidearm and a note explaining his fate. After finding his body, the player can then return to Milly.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
• Wild Bill's Sidearm
• Six stimpaks

qst_0200108d.summary: The dramatic finale of The Pitt: an audience with former Brotherhood of Steel Paladin Ishmael Ashur in Haven, discovering that the "cure" is his newborn daughter Marie, and a wrenching moral choice between Ashur's harsh order and Wernher's bloody uprising.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Retrieve personal gear:
As soon as the three rounds of fighting in the Hole, Krenshaw arrives to tell the Lone Wanderer that they are free and Ashur wishes to speak to them in Uptown. The Wanderer will then be free to retrieve the equipment taken by the Pitt raiders from the footlocker in the middle of the room and head to Ashur. Attacking any Pitt raiders in Downtown before speaking to Ashur will turn the raiders in Uptown hostile. Should they become hostile, waiting a few in-game days will be needed for them to be friendly again.

Speak to Ashur in Haven:
Once there, Ashur asks the Wanderer to kill Wernher, as he's been rallying the slaves and a riot would result in meaningless death. Passing a Speech challenge, the player character can tell Ashur that they have never met Wernher or that they didn't like his looks.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
• 150 XP
• Ashur's power armor
• Booster Shot
• Access to the ammo press

qst_0200108c.summary: Journeying north to the radio tower of escaped Pitt resident Wernher: acquiring a slave outfit for disguise, riding a handcar through the train tunnel, and passing the confiscation checkpoint on the bridge into The Pitt.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Investigate the distress call:
When The Pitt first loads, the player character will be informed of a new radio distress signal, "Wernher's distress signal". It is a looping broadcast from a runaway slave named Wernher, who informs the listener he is from a settlement to the north and has valuable information for anyone who is willing to help him free his people.

The signal emanates from the radio tower far to the north of the Capital Wasteland. It is a long walk from anywhere, but the closest map marker to fast travel to is SatCom Array NN-03d. Once arriving at the tower, Wernher will be under attack by a few Pitt raiders.

After helping him dispatch his foes, Wernher will tell the player character his story and more information.

sections.title: Exploits
sections.text:
Keeping your items in the Pitt:
The forced conversation with Mex (and the subsequent confiscation of your items) can be avoided when approaching the main gate. This is done by switching to unarmed combat, standing directly underneath the raider on the overhead catwalk, jumping and entering V.A.T.S. while in midair, then throwing a single punch; the punch will miss but will leave you on top of the catwalk, standing next to the raider. By quickly jumping down from the catwalk you can avoid the conversation trigger entirely. Be warned that if you do not jump down from the catwalk fast enough the trigger will activate and your controls will be locked, rendering you unable to move, and Mex will not be able to reach you to initiate the conversation, thus keeping you in this state indefinitely.

qst_0200108b.summary: Trials of a slave in The Pitt's Downtown: meeting Wernher's contact Midea, hunting for Steel Ingots among feral Trogs in the Steelyard, and fighting three lethal bouts in the irradiated arena known as The Hole to earn your freedom and reclaim your gear.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
A Warm Welcome:
Depending on dialogue choices, the Lone Wanderer may be beaten unconscious by the Pitt raiders, or they may walk to Midea's quarters without too much harassment from the raiders.

Once inside, Midea will inform the player character of her goal: to steal The Cure from Ashur. The conversation is then interrupted by Jackson, a Pitt raider, who interrogates Midea as to what they were talking about. She stammers out a lie about the Lone Wanderer being the new "volunteer." Jackson buys it and leaves the player character and her alone. She instructs the Lone Wanderer to go and gather steel ingots from the steelyard, because slaves that do not work are not tolerated. If the player character inquires about weapons, she will point to Marco in The Mill.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
• 150 XP
• Auto Axpert perk
• Pitt Fighter perk

qst_03004c75.summary: Investigating the disappearance of Megaton's water caravans: infiltrating the monastery of the Apostles of the Eternal Light in Springvale, where Mother Curie III's fanatics irradiate water to "convert" wastelanders into ghouls.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
This quest will not be offered if Megaton was destroyed during The Power of the Atom. The Lone Wanderer picks up this quest from Scribe Bigsley after asking him what they can do to help. He asks them to investigate the area around Megaton to see why they need more water, after just being sent a week's shipment of Aqua Pura.

Investigate the vicinity of Megaton:
There are three ways to discover what is going on:
- Most prominently, approaching the entrance to Megaton in the wasteland will trigger a scripted scene between a wastelander named Rosa and a generic water beggar (fully identical to Megaton's normal water beggar Micky, but named differently for plausible deniability if Micky is already dead). During the scene, Rosa will be seen giving seemingly pure water to the beggar, who drinks it and immediately dies.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Speak with Scribe Bigsley at the Jefferson Memorial, or find missionary Brother Gerard and a sect pamphlet outside Megaton's gates. Primary locations: Wasteland, Jefferson Museum and Gift Shop, Eternal Light Monastery, DC Ruins Sector DC10b (Jefferson Memorial).

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Reward from Scribe Bigsley and restored Aqua Pura deliveries to Megaton; Supply of "Holy Water" and rare chems from the monastery basement. Key participants: Brother Gerard, Micky, Rosa, Scribe Bigsley, Water Beggar, Novice.

qst_03003b67.summary: Exposing the ghoul Griffon's scam outside the Museum of History: uncovering how the hustler turns the Brotherhood's pure water into the radioactive counterfeit "Aqua Cura" that supposedly restores ghouls' hair and smooth skin.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Griffon, a ghoul outside of Underworld, is selling Aqua Cura, a tonic that he claims will cure the ghoul condition; however, you learn the truth behind the re-branding soon enough.

There are four ways to begin this quest. The first option is to talk to Griffon in the Museum of History and ask for a bottle of Aqua Cura. According to your Pip-Boy, though, the water is irradiated. If you bring this fact up to Griffon, he will deny this by claiming "your Pipsqueak 2000 or whatever it's called is broken" and the quest will be added. It can also be added by either passing a speech check with Scribe Bigsley or by hacking his terminal.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
• 100 XP
• 400 - 600 caps (Optional)
• Bad Karma (Optional)

qst_03003b42.summary: Investigating raids on Rivet City's water caravans for Scribe Bigsley and Officer Lepelletier: tracking One-Eyed Jack's gang to Wilhelm's Wharf, fighting an honorable melee duel, or running a protection racket.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Scribe Bigsley asks the Lone Wanderer to investigate the organized bandit attacks on the Aqua Pura caravans, directing the Lone Wanderer to speak with Officer Lepelletier of Rivet City for more details. Scribe Bigsley does not have to be spoken to at all; Officer Lepelletier will give the quest as well.

Consult Officer Lepelletier:
Officer Lepelletier can be found on the first floor of the ramp area entrance of Rivet City. She will explain that a water caravan heading towards Canterbury Commons has just left the Jefferson Memorial and will ask the player to travel with it and discover who is behind the hijacking. The player is asked to catch up with the caravan, and speak with Officers Davis and Lorin who are escorting it.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text:
• 100 XP
• Enclave power armor and helmet
• Gatling laser
• Plasma pistol
• 29 electron charge packs
• 16 energy cells

qst_030011ad.summary: The decisive strike against Adams Air Force Base: navigating the secret Presidential Metro beneath the White House, storming the Enclave's massive Mobile Base Crawler, and choosing the target of the orbital strike.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text: Paladin Tristan has tasked the Lone Wanderer with infiltrating the Enclave's final, massive base at Adams Air Force Base, and destroying it with an orbital strike. The quest begins at White House Plaza. The utility tunnel that leads to the White House now also has a connection to the Presidential metro, which should lead directly to Adams Air Force Base. Reach White House Plaza and enter the tunnels. The metro is crawling with feral ghouls, Mister Gutsies and sentry bots. The player will proceed down several different tunnels before meeting with M.A.R.Go.T., the protector, and dispatcher of the metro.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text:
• 1500 XP
• Tesla cannon
• ±1000 Karma

qst_03000afd.summary: Hacking the Enclave's orbital targeting system: descending into Olney Powerworks beneath Old Olney, overrun by deadly Deathclaws, to recover a Tesla Coil.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Talk to Paladin Tristan:
Right after completing Death From Above, the Lone Wanderer is told to talk to Paladin Tristan in the Citadel. Tristan briefs them on their next mission, which is to retrieve a pre-War experimental device called a Tesla coil from the remains of Olney Powerworks. The scribes need the coil to finish a little surprise for the Enclave: the Tesla cannon.

(Optional) Use Enclave-controlled deathclaws:
If Tristan is asked for a little help, he tells the Lone Wanderer to talk to Scribe Vallincourt in the Citadel laboratory. She offers a deathclaw control scrambler which allows the Lone Wanderer to "hijack" Enclave-controlled deathclaws so long as they are within range of an Enclave transmitter.

Southeast of Old Olney is an Enclave camp where the controller can be tested.

sections.title: Story Role & Setup
sections.text: Report to Scribe Rothchild after "Death From Above". Primary locations: Old Olney Underground, Olney Powerworks, Citadel - Laboratory, Citadel - A Ring, Old Olney S. Wilson Building, Utility.

sections.title: Participants, Choices & Rewards
sections.text: Rewards: Tesla Cannon (upon completing component assembly at the Citadel); Access to the Presidential Metro. Key participants: Paladin Tristan, Scribe Vallincourt, Wint, Kidd.

qst_03000802.summary: Waking up in the Citadel two weeks after activating Project Purity: the Brotherhood is distributing water, while the Enclave has regrouped at a new base. Escort Liberty Prime to the Rockland Satellite Relay.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: The Lone Wanderer is sent to assist a Brotherhood assault on an Enclave outpost at the southwest corner of the map, west of the Dunwich Building, reached via the Rockland car tunnel. The satellite relay station is in a new area altogether and is heavily defended by Enclave soldiers.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Talk to Scribe Rothchild:
The player character wakes up in the Citadel's clinic after completing the Take it Back! quest and is greeted by Elder Lyons, who promotes them to the rank of Knight and gives a short overview of what happened during the two weeks they have been unconscious. He then requests they go see Scribe Rothchild for a more detailed briefing. Rothchild explains how the Brotherhood systematically attacked Enclave camps with the help of Liberty Prime, which has proven to be far more effective than expected. The objective of the mission is to learn how the Enclave is still able to communicate and coordinate their scattered forces, even though Raven Rock has been destroyed. It is believed that the Enclave-controlled satellite relay station might be able to provide answers.

sections.title: Transition quotes
sections.text:
• - Paladin Tristan
• - Elder Lyons
• - Scribe Rothchild

qst_04009b5e.summary: The bloody attraction of "Plik's Safari" inside a Point Lookout sea cave: eccentric ghoul hunter Plik charges 1,000 caps to test your mettle in an underground arena against waves of frenzied feral ghouls and glowing ones.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
When first entering the coastal grotto, there is a small room on the right which contains Plik's journal (on the desk), and some minor loot. Reading it awards the Ghoul Ecology perk, which gives a 5 point damage bonus when fighting ghouls. Plik is located further down the hallway, and offers a chance to join his small hunting club, but only if paid the entry fee of 1,000 caps. Pay the fee, and ask to join in the next safari.

Join the safari:
Enter the door behind Plik, and meet the other contestants for this hunting excursion, Jacob Humboldt and Rip Smithy. After preparations have been made to begin the hunt, flip the switch on the block in the center of the room.

Survive Plik's Safari:
Several waves of leveled feral ghouls, ranging from swamp ghouls to glowing ones will begin swarming the platform and immediate area.

sections.title: Reward
sections.text: The Dismemberer and 100 XP. After the last feral ghoul stops breathing, the safari is over. Walk out, and talk to Plik to receive the reward: The Dismemberer, a unique axe Plik pilfered from one of his club members who "won't be needing it anymore."

qst_0400815c.summary: Befriend the orphaned boy Kenny inside the abandoned Herzog Mine: play games of tag and hide-and-seek through the mine tunnels, gift him a teddy bear, and earn a permanent safe haven to rest in Point Lookout.

sections.title: Background
sections.text:
Fleeing the other swampfolk because he was not born with the right "look," Kenny is a lonely child looking for a friend to play with. He lives in the Herzog Mine. Kenny is exceptional at rigging traps.

Kenny was born to swampfolk and spent his early childhood hidden in his parent's basement because he "don't got the marks" which caused the other swampfolk to shoot at him like they would shoot at the others without the marks. During his time in the cellar, he learned how to make traps by taking apart and rebuilding anything he could find. He later ran away from home and took up residence in the old mine, where he is found in 2277. Kenny might have chosen the mine because rumors of it being haunted would keep locals away.

sections.title: Daily schedule
sections.text: Kenny stays in his makeshift house and, on occasion, shoots junk off of a shelf with his BB gun for target practice.

sections.title: Interactions with the player character
sections.text:
Effects of player's actions:
With a Speech check, using Child at Heart or by retrieving his Kenny-bear from the bottom of the mine's shaft, the Lone Wanderer can convince Kenny to let them stay with him in the mine, and use his containers. One can also play either tag or hide-and-seek with him when asked.

Other interactions:
• When asked about Old Man Herzog, Kenny will say he hung himself. When one travels deeper into the mine (Blackdamp Shaft), they can see a skeleton dangling by its neck from a rope.
• One can return Kenny-bear to Kenny, even if he has been convinced to let the Lone Wanderer stay. However, there is no reward other than his thanks.

qst_0400584b.summary: The alternate finale in the underground lighthouse bunker (Professor Calvert's path): eliminating Desmond Lockhart on the Brain's orders, Calvert's inevitable betrayal, and battling his security robots.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
After watching the Calvert Mansion explode, the Panic Room can be entered through a hatch in the ruins. There is some minor loot including ammunition and food, such as a Nuka-Cola Quantum and two very rare gum drops.

This mission begins slightly differently depending on who was sided with in Thought Control, either Desmond Lockheart or Professor Calvert. In either case, go to the Point Lookout Lighthouse where a section of the floor slides away. The final showdown takes place in St. Aubin Medical Facility, a secret underground lab.

Sided with Desmond:
The player character installed the cogwave jammer and sided with Desmond.
• Find Desmond. He is fuming inside the panic room about Calvert killing his dogs Freki and Geri.
• Tell Desmond you are ready.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text: In the sealed room, there are 2 ammunition boxes, a safe, 2 first aid boxes, some energy weapon ammunition, some misc. items, and the microwave emitter. There is also a ladder leading outside.

qst_0400584a.summary: Showdown of a century-old rivalry beneath the Point Lookout Lighthouse (Desmond Lockhart's path): descending into the secret biolab beneath the lighthouse, fighting past security robots, and destroying the tank holding Professor Calvert's brain.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
After watching the Calvert Mansion explode, the Panic Room can be entered through a hatch in the ruins. There is some minor loot including ammunition and food, such as a Nuka-Cola Quantum and two very rare gum drops.

This mission begins slightly differently depending on who was sided with in Thought Control, either Desmond Lockheart or Professor Calvert. In either case, go to the Point Lookout Lighthouse where a section of the floor slides away. The final showdown takes place in St. Aubin Medical Facility, a secret underground lab.

Sided with Desmond:
The player character installed the cogwave jammer and sided with Desmond.
• Find Desmond. He is fuming inside the panic room about Calvert killing his dogs Freki and Geri.
• Tell Desmond you are ready.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.text: In the sealed room, there are 2 ammunition boxes, a safe, 2 first aid boxes, some energy weapon ammunition, some misc. items, and the microwave emitter. There is also a ladder leading outside.

qst_04005849.summary: Psychic warfare between Calvert and Desmond: planting or destroying a telepathic jammer on the Ferris wheel, taking revenge on ferryman Tobar for stealing a piece of your brain, and the bombing of Calvert Mansion.

sections.title: Detailed walkthrough
sections.text:
Talk to Desmond:
Desmond Lockheart reveals the brain to be Professor Calvert, a brilliant pre-War scientist and the last remaining member of the Calvert family.
